closed_recent.author: HongyeZhou
closed_recent.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**What happens.** In the desktop app, once a Session has already run one evolution search — even a **finished** one — starting a second search in that same Session fails. The agent's `create_evolve_run` tool answers

```
TOOL_EXECUTION_FAILED  Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'kind')  retryable: false
```

and no run is created. There is no readable refusal, no field name, and no stack trace anywhere to look at. The only workaround is to open a new Session, which throws away the workspace (`sk/evaluator.py`, `sk/candidate.py`) and the whole design context.

**Steps to reproduce.**

1. Desktop app → new Session → `/evolve-design --algorithm puct <task>`; walk the four design checkpoints and let the run start and finish (`status: succeeded`).
2. In the same Session, ask for a second search — e.g. "start the same search again, same parameters, `expansions` 60" — or simply run `/evolve-design` again.
3. `create_evolve_run` returns the error above and no run appears.
4. Repeating with `checkpointMode: "auto"` vs `"confirm"`, and with `expansions: 37` vs `40`, gives the identical message. It is not the parameters.
5. Calling `stop_evolve_run` on the finished run answers `Search <id> is not running any more (status: succeeded)` — there is nothing left to stop, and the second start still fails.

**Measured on 2026-11-22** (Session `252ca40d-bd4d-4534-8913-f323320e383e`, finished run `df752fc3-6212-4135-adce-f54bde93f2c1`, `succeeded`, 11/12 candidates, best 0.4844 equal to the baseline): three `create_evolve_run` calls at 12:15:57Z, 12:16:59Z and 12:17:18Z all failed the same way; no run record was created; the turn spent roughly 310k tokens and produced nothing.

**Where it breaks (read on `main` @ bbdbdd5c):**

- `services/api/src/evolution/proposal.ts` — `measureOf()` is a `switch (proposal.mode)` with **no `default`**. A missing or unexpected `mode` falls through and returns `undefined`, so the `criterion` assembled right after it has `measure === undefined`.
- `services/api/src/evolution/preflight.ts:148` — the first reader: `criterion.measure.kind !== "llm_judge" ...` throws `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'kind')`. That exact message is what the tool call reports back.
- `services/api/src/bootstrap/platform.ts` — the second-start guard filters to *active* runs (`isEvolveRunActive(run.status)`), so a `succeeded` run correctly does not trip it. The request passes the guard and reaches the crash above.
- `packages/evolve/src/index.ts` — the `create_evolve_run` tool declares no `requiredArguments` (unlike `stop_evolve_run`, which declares `["runId"]`), and `packages/tools/src/registry.ts`'s `executeRegistered` calls `tool.execute(id, args as never)` without checking `args` against the tool's TypeBox schema. So a proposal whose `mode` is missing is never rejected as a bad argument.
- `packages/tools/src/registry.ts:596-614` — the `catch` keeps only `message.slice(0, 1000)` and `retryable`; it does not log the stack. That is why neither the API log nor the data log contains anything about this failure, and why this report quotes an error string instead of a stack.

**Expected.** A refusal the agent can act on ("`mode` is required / must be one of …"), or a validated-argument error naming the field; and in any case a logged stack when an unexpected `TypeError` escapes a tool.

**Actual.** An opaque `TOOL_EXECUTION_FAILED` with no stack and no log, and the second search is impossible in that Session.

**Why it matters beyond this one failure**

- The `evolve-design` skill tells the agent to stop the running search and then create a replacement when the target changes. After the first run finishes, that documented path is dead in the same Session.
- The message is unactionable, so the model guesses. In our session it first "re-checked the token budget" (40 → 37 expansions), then blamed `checkpointMode: "auto"` and retried as `"confirm"` — three attempts, ~310k tokens, no result.

**Suggested direction** (not a prescription)

- Give `measureOf()` a `default:` that throws a `ProposalRefusal("mode must be one of …")`, so the agent sees a refusal rather than a crash.
- Validate tool arguments against the tool's own schema before `execute`, or declare `requiredArguments: ["mode", …]` on `create_evolve_run` — the gateway already withholds incomplete calls through that mechanism (`jiuwenswarm-model-gateway.ts:445`).
- Log name + stack in the tool registry's `catch` while still returning only the truncated message to the model.

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- Server: Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS, x86_64; Node v22.23.2; pnpm 11.1.2.
- Source checkout of `main` @ `bbdbdd5c9e7d04de3ff1d33da52eb41b87d60c9a` (2026-11-22T01:36:38Z), started from source: API on `127.0.0.1:4410`, Runner on `4411`, desktop web build on `5174`.
- Evolve sidecar: `services/evolve` venv (Python 3.12), `uvicorn sciencediscovery_evolve.server:app` on `127.0.0.1:17676`, `SCIENCE_AGENT_EVOLVE_URL` pointed at it; `GET /api/evolve/status` → `{"state":"ready","canInitialize":false,"sandbox":"bwrap"}`.
- Model: `deepseek-v4.1-flash` through the Ark endpoint configured in the app.
- Session `252ca40d-bd4d-4534-8913-f323320e383e`; finished run `df752fc3-6212-4135-adce-f54bde93f2c1`; three failing `create_evolve_run` calls as listed above.

### Additional Information

- I could not find a duplicate. #997 (closed) is "the agent cannot stop an evolve search, so correcting the score formula starts a second concurrent run" — that one is about two searches running at once; this one is a crash on the second create after the first has already finished.
- A screenshot does not help: the failure is a tool result string, and the interesting part is the code path.
- Reproduces 3/3 on this stack.

### Version Information

- Desktop app: source run of `main` @ `bbdbdd5c` (not a packaged release).
- Files inspected: `services/api/src/evolution/proposal.ts`, `services/api/src/evolution/preflight.ts`, `services/api/src/bootstrap/platform.ts`, `packages/evolve/src/index.ts`, `packages/tools/src/registry.ts`.

### Checklist - [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help. - [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version. - [x] The description below includes environment information and a minimal reproduction, so the report can be followed without further questions. ### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem **Summary** The approval card is mixed-language: the eyebrow and the buttons are Chinese, while the one line that says what is about to be authorized is a hard-coded English sentence. ``` 需要权限 Run a shell script in the Session workspace <- English, from the server workspace-code <- resource id [仅允许一次] [允许同类操作] [拒绝] <- Chinese, from the client ``` ![The permission card: Chinese heading and buttons around an English summary](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a489fefc-8fa8-4441-baa8-0695105e1463) **Steps to reproduce** 1. Language zh-CN, permission mode "请求批准" (ask for approval). 2. Ask the agent to run any shell command in the session workspace. 3. The approval card appears with the English summary above. **Root cause** `apps/desktop/src/views/PermissionCard.tsx:58` renders the summary verbatim: ```tsx {TEXT.permission.required}

{request.summary}

``` and the server builds `summary` as an English sentence. Every approval path does this, not only the shell one: - `services/api/src/agent-run/workspace-bindings.ts:297` — `Run a shell script …` - `:623` — `Run Python code …`, `:786` — `Run ${language} code …` - `:398` — the `DIRECT HOST EXECUTION: Runner …, account …, No sandbox filesystem, process or network isolation; …` warning - `:526` — `Copy N selected files between authorized Workspaces` - `:555`, `:576` — NPU job cancel/run - `services/api/src/agent-run/jiuwenswarm-agent.ts:333` — `Call repaired MCP tool …`, `:554` — `tool call` - `services/api/src/agent-run/sandbox-network-consent.ts:52` — `Sandbox network on … for this Agent run: …` The action and resource fields (`code`, `workspace-code`) are raw identifiers by design and are acceptable as such; the summary is prose and is not translated anywhere. **Impact** - This is the sentence a user must understand before granting shell, Python or **direct host** execution. A Chinese-reading user sees the button labels but not the scope being granted, so approving becomes a reflex — and the direct-host warning (no filesystem, process or network isolation; host credentials reachable; effects not reversible) is the most consequential text in the product. - It makes an otherwise fully localized surface look broken, and the same card is used in the walkthrough that a reviewer sees on a screenshot. - It also affects matching consent: "允许同类操作" scopes a broader grant, and the user cannot check what "同类" means because the description is unreadable. **Suggested fix** Send structured fields instead of a finished English sentence, and let the client compose the text from its own catalog: e.g. `{ kind: "shell" | "python" | "language" | "file-copy" | "npu-run" | "mcp-tool" | "network", target, scope, hosts?, language?, remoteHostAlias? }`, with the current English string kept as a fallback for builds that cannot render the structured form. Where the API must stay the source of truth (the direct-host warning), translate by the request's locale, which the API already knows from the session's language preference. Whichever route is taken, the direct-host warning deserves its own copy pass: it is several sentences of consequences and should be readable, not just shorter. ### Detailed Environment Information Description - Product: ScienceDiscovery `main` at `bbdbdd5c9e7d04de3ff1d33da52eb41b87d60c9a` (2026-11-21). API `127.0.0.1:4410`, Runner `127.0.0.1:4411`, desktop web surface `http://127.0.0.1:5174`. - Host: Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS, Node.js 22.23.2, pnpm 11.1.2. - Client: Playwright Chromium build 1228, 1600x1000 viewport, locale `zh-CN`, permission mode "请求批准". - Observed on `run_shell` in the session workspace (resource `workspace-code`); the same rendering path is shared by every tool that asks for approval. ### Additional Information - Found while fault-injecting approval requirements for scenario S-203 (fault recovery). - The same untranslated-summary shape appears in the run failure card (#1292) and the model connection test (#1299) from the same round of testing; this issue is specifically about the approval card. ### Version Information - Repository: `openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery`, branch `main` - Commit: `bbdbdd5c9e7d04de3ff1d33da52eb41b87d60c9a` (2026-11-21) - Desktop app package version: `0.0.0` (private workspace package)

closed_recent.author: HongyeZhou
closed_recent.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**What happens.** In the desktop app, a report's citation chip (for example `[evidence1]`) opens the 科学记忆 card. When the memory graph cannot answer — the sidecar is restarting, or it refuses the query with its 503 budget limit — the card correctly says "暂时读不到科学记忆 / 记忆服务没有响应。稍后再试一次。", but the **only action it offers is "打开科学记忆设置" (Open scientific memory settings)**. The wording invites a retry; the UI has no retry. To get the content the reader has to close the card and press the citation again.

**Steps to reproduce.**

1. Desktop app, memory graph enabled, and a report whose body cites evidence (a chip such as `[evidence1]`).
2. Make the memory graph unavailable: stop the memory-graph sidecar, or let it refuse with its 503 budget limit, so `POST /api/memory/query/by-node-type` answers `{"hits":[],"total":0,"truncated":false,"reason":"memory_graph_unreachable"}`.
3. Press the `[evidence1]` chip in the report.

**Expected.** The card offers "重试" (retry), which re-reads this reference in place; once the service is back, pressing it shows the evidence without closing the card.

**Actual.** The card shows the unreachable message and its only button is "打开科学记忆设置" — a settings page that cannot affect a transient outage (and that may even read "运行正常" at that moment, because its status line reads the unauthenticated `/api/health`). No retry is offered anywhere in the card.

**Why (code, main).** `apps/desktop/src/views/MemoryCardDialog.tsx`:

- `:170-177` — `memory_graph_disabled` → `{ offerSettings: true }`
- `:183-190` — `memory_graph_unreachable` / `memory_graph_query_limit` → `{ offerSettings: true }`
- `:195-203` — the request failed outright → `{ offerSettings: true }`
- `:268-270` — the action is one ternary over that flag:
  `action={state.offerSettings ? TEXT.memory.openSettings : TEXT.memory.retry}` and
  `onAction={state.offerSettings ? onOpenSettings : () => setAttempt((v) => v + 1)}`

Because every error state sets `offerSettings: true`, the `重试` label and the `setAttempt` re-read path are unreachable — `attempt` never changes, so the effect never runs again.

**Impact.** Transient unavailability is a normal state (sidecar restart, query budget refusal), yet the only recovery is to close the card and press the citation again. The card's own sentence ("稍后再试一次") promises an action the UI does not provide.

**Suggested fix (not a prescription).** Give the action to the state rather than to one flag: `disabled` keeps "打开科学记忆设置"; `unreachable` / `query_limit` / request-failure render "重试" (the existing `setAttempt` path), optionally with "打开科学记忆设置" as a secondary link.

**Screenshots.** Both are the same card at two error states; the action button sits at the same place in both.

A — memory graph unreachable (the bug):

![A: unreachable — the only action is Open settings](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/fb7620cd-de7a-4bf6-bc4a-676640feb011)

B — single card, unreachable, button highlighted:

![B: unreachable card, button highlighted](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ded64ffe-b0fc-4a56-ae8c-134a0580c252)

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- Desktop web surface (`apps/desktop`) served at `http://127.0.0.1:5174` from a checkout of `main` at the SHA below; Linux x64 host, Chromium 1228, viewport 1500×950, `zh-CN`.
- Backend in the same host: API on `127.0.0.1:4410`, runner on `4411`; memory graph sidecar with the `local` backend on `127.0.0.1:17675`; 科学记忆 enabled.
- No cloud model is needed to reproduce — the card fails before any model call. The report used for the screenshots contains two evidence citations.
- Stopping only the sidecar is enough; the API and the rest of the app stay up.

### Additional Information

- Reproducible with the sidecar's 503 budget refusal as well (`reason: memory_graph_query_limit`), which the code already treats as a temporary failure rather than a missing record — so the retry is meaningful in exactly the case the card refuses to offer it.
- The three error states are distinguishable in the code (`disabled` vs `temporarily unavailable` vs request failure); only the action collapses them into one.
- Related but separate: the settings page's status line reads the unauthenticated `/api/health`, so it can report "运行正常" while every query is refused; that is a different report.

### Version Information

- Repository `openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery`, `main` at `bbdbdd5c9e7d04de3ff1d33da52eb41b87d60c9a` (2026-11-22T01:36:38Z).
- Affected file: `apps/desktop/src/views/MemoryCardDialog.tsx` (lines 170-177, 183-190, 195-203, 268-270).
- Evidence captured 2026-11-22 on that SHA.

closed_recent.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] The description below includes environment information and a minimal reproduction, so the report can be followed without further questions.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**Summary**

Publishing an artifact whose bytes are identical to the latest version still creates a new version. In the observed run the same `README.md` was published twice, 17 seconds apart, with an identical content hash — so the version picker now offers `v2` and `v3` that are byte-for-byte the same.

**What happened**

In the delivery session (`9797f503`, scenario S-201), `README.md` was published three times:

```
README.md v1  3fcc605bc51680c3…  2026-11-22T10:06:52.311Z
README.md v2  20d7e09035a76452…  2026-11-22T10:09:17.843Z
README.md v3  20d7e09035a76452…  2026-11-22T10:09:34.364Z   <-- same hash, same 8921 bytes
```

`v2` and `v3` carry the same `content.hash` and the same `content.size`. The same thing happened once on `analysis/consistency-review.md` in the same session (a rewrite that only touched another artifact). The model had "verified and republished" the document; nothing changed.

The workspace file matches `v3` byte-for-byte, so this is not a stale-pointer problem: the server really was asked to publish the same body again and did.

**Why it happens**

`services/api/src/store.ts:5789-5801` always builds a version and pushes it:

```ts
const version = { …, version: artifact.currentVersion + 1 };
artifact.currentVersion = version.version;
this.catalog.artifactVersions.push(version);
```

There is a guard for a stale base (`ARTIFACT_VERSION_CONFLICT`) and, since #1301, one for duplicate numbers — but no comparison between the incoming `content.hash` and the latest version's `content.hash`. The `publicationId` de-duplication at `:5731` only covers a retried *publication* of the same call, not a new publish of identical bytes.

**Impact**

- The version picker labels versions by number alone (`v3`, `v2`, `v1`), so a user choosing between `v2` and `v3` has no way to know they are the same document. The one question version history exists to answer — "what changed?" — gets a wrong answer.
- Publishing is a normal part of every run: the model rewrites and republishes a document after each verification pass. Unchanged republishes therefore accumulate, and each one also bumps `currentVersion` and `updatedAt`, which feeds the project-wide ordering.
- Combined with cross-session continuation (#1306) the chain grows across conversations, so noise compounds rather than staying local to one session.
- Download and preview of `v2`/`v3` return identical bytes; any diff-based review of versions shows "no changes" and wastes a review cycle.

**Suggested fix**

Treat a publish whose body equals the latest version as a no-op:

- in `publishArtifact`, if `explicit` is set and the latest version has the same `content.hash`, `content.size` and `mediaType`, return that version instead of appending a new one (the call already returns `{ artifact, version }`, so callers need no change);
- if the caller explicitly wants a new number (annotation-only republish), let it pass a flag, e.g. `forceNewVersion`;
- keep the current behaviour when the body differs, and keep the `ARTIFACT_VERSION_CONFLICT` / `ARTIFACT_VERSION_DUPLICATE` guards as they are.

A regression test next to the auto-increment test in `services/api/src/store.test.ts` would pin it: publish the same hash twice, expect one version.

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- Product: ScienceDiscovery `main` at `bbdbdd5c9e7d04de3ff1d33da52eb41b87d60c9a` (2026-11-21). API `127.0.0.1:4410`, Runner `127.0.0.1:4411`, desktop web surface `http://127.0.0.1:5174`.
- Host: Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS, Node.js 22.23.2, pnpm 11.1.2.
- Client: Playwright Chromium build 1228, 1600x1000 viewport, locale `zh-CN`.
- Artifact data read from `/api/sessions/<id>/artifact-outputs`; the `README.md` content hash equals the sha256 of the workspace file.

### Additional Information

- Found while running scenario S-201 (deliver a research package across sessions).
- Related but separate: #1300 / #1301 (version-number allocation and its uniqueness guard) and #1306 (a new session silently continuing an existing version chain). This issue is only about identical content receiving a new number.
- No screenshot: the defect is in the publish path; the visible consequence is two identical entries in the version picker.

### Version Information

- Repository: `openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery`, branch `main`
- Commit: `bbdbdd5c9e7d04de3ff1d33da52eb41b87d60c9a` (2026-11-21)
- Desktop app package version: `0.0.0` (private workspace package)

closed_recent.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**What happens.** During a long agent turn, the model can return a terminal turn that carries reasoning but neither text nor a tool call. The API detects it (`EmptyModelTurnError`) and **fails the whole turn** — no retry, no continuation. In the desktop app the turn becomes 运行异常 with `semantic-error`, and the only way forward is for the user to send another message ("继续 step 3") to resume the work.

On this stack that happened in the middle of an `evolve-design` session: 522k tokens of context, 30+ model calls into the design, and the turn died. The failed turn alone had spent **313.9k tokens**. Nothing was wrong with the request — the provider answered `httpStatus=200` — so the user has no way to tell a model hiccup from a broken environment.

**Steps to reproduce.** Probabilistic, not deterministic — it needs the provider to return a reasoning-only terminal turn:

1. Run a long agent turn that keeps a large context and many tool calls — an `evolve-design` session is a reliable shape (four checkpoints, file writes, `run_shell` evaluations, a probe).
2. At some point the provider returns `finishReason=stop` with `hasReasoning=true` and no content and no tool calls.
3. The turn fails immediately. In our session the UI showed 运行异常 → 技术详情 with the string below.

**Exact error, 2026-11-22T11:03Z:**

```
semantic-error
Model returned an empty terminal turn (no text and no tool call)
[requestId=model-a0251aa1-6e7b-4240-bcc8-60d8fed93204
 endpoint=https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com
 model=deepseek-v4.1-flash
 httpStatus=200
 upstreamRequestId=021795343897601b97e702619832bacb4ebf6c3ac1ede67c2cd25
 sseRecords=620 sseParseErrors=0 finishReason=stop hasReasoning=true retries=0]
```

Note `retries=0`: the turn was not retried even once, and `sseRecords=620 / sseParseErrors=0` says the stream itself was well-formed.

**Where it breaks (read on `main` @ bbdbdd5c):**

- `packages/model/src/client.ts:192` — `isEmptyTerminalTurn()`: not truncated, no tool calls, empty content → an empty terminal turn. `:167` defines `EmptyModelTurnError`; `:207` classifies it as `reasoning_only` (reasoning was observed) or `empty_completion` (nothing at all).
- `services/api/src/agent-run/jiuwenswarm-model-gateway.ts:440` — a non-auxiliary (task) turn that is empty is thrown as `EmptyModelTurnError`.
- `services/api/src/agent-run/jiuwenswarm-agent.ts:433` — the turn's `catch` handles truncation recovery and withheld tool arguments, then does a bare `throw error`. There is no retry path for this class, so the run ends.
- The detection is intentional — `services/api/src/agent-run/jiuwenswarm-model-gateway.test.ts:1085` asserts that a reasoning-only turn is reported as a mid-stream error. The missing piece is recovery, not detection.

**Expected.** `reasoning_only` / `empty_completion` are transient provider behaviour, so they should be retried within the same turn (bounded, e.g. one or two attempts, optionally with a higher `maxTokens` or with reasoning dropped for that retry), and only fail after that. When it does finally fail, say so in user language ("the model returned nothing that round; retried N times") rather than surfacing `semantic-error`.

**Actual.** One reasoning-only turn discards the whole turn: the 313.9k tokens already spent on it produce nothing, the design conversation stops mid-step, and the user is told to retry.

**Why it matters beyond this one turn**

- The cost is asymmetric. A design turn here is minutes of work and hundreds of thousands of tokens; a provider hiccup that costs one retry instead costs the entire turn.
- It scales with turn count. A four-checkpoint design is several turns; any one of them failing ends the chain. Long flows — `evolve-design`, Idea Tree research, long literature reports — accumulate this failure rate.
- It is indistinguishable from a real fault. An empty turn and a genuinely broken tool/environment both show up as 运行异常, with the difference buried inside 技术详情, so the user cannot triage and every occurrence looks like the feature is broken.

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- Server: Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS, x86_64; Node v22.23.2.
- Source checkout of `main` @ `bbdbdd5c9e7d04de3ff1d33da52eb41b87d60c9a` (2026-11-22T01:36:38Z), started from source: API on `127.0.0.1:4410`, Runner on `4411`, desktop web build on `5174`.
- Model endpoint: `https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com`, model `deepseek-v4.1-flash`, `thinking` on for this Session.
- Session: `252ca40d-bd4d-4534-8913-f323320e383e` (an `evolve-design` session; context was ~522k tokens when it failed).
- The failed turn's diagnostics are quoted in full above, including `requestId` and `upstreamRequestId`, so the provider side can be checked from those.

### Additional Information

- Related but different: #245 (closed) investigated empty terminal turns as a latency/perf question for Biomni endpoints. This report is about reliability: the turn fails outright instead of being retried.
- Recovery cost is real but cheap to observe: after re-sending "继续 step 3" the same session continued normally, which is why this reads as a missing retry rather than a broken task.
- No screenshot needed — the diagnostics string above is the evidence, and it is what the UI's 技术详情 panel prints.

### Version Information

- Desktop app: source run of `main` @ `bbdbdd5c` (not a packaged release).
- Files inspected: `packages/model/src/client.ts`, `packages/model/src/runtime-client.ts`, `services/api/src/agent-run/jiuwenswarm-model-gateway.ts`, `services/api/src/agent-run/jiuwenswarm-agent.ts`.

closed_recent.author: yuanzhou75
closed_recent.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

The Idea Tree real-model L4 journey in #1293 passes only about half the time on the same commit. The failure is not in the assertion or the sandbox: the agent sometimes spends its whole preparation budget exploring the workspace and skill directories and never calls `create_idea_research`, so no research exists and the case fails waiting for the research card.

## Observed

Two runs, same head `a5f028cdad2a0a473b3c926704fc84f373f10d4f`, same prompt, same settings (water-treatment template, `quick`), same model:

| Run | Result |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | passed — `1 passed (8.2m)`, `playwright_exit=0` |
| 2 | failed — step 1 `getByRole('region', { name: 'Idea Tree 研究控制' })`, `Timeout: 180000ms exceeded`, `element(s) not found`, case body 3.2 min |

In the passing run the model called the tool after ~72s. In the failing run it was still exploring at round 4:

```
已探索 …
已调用 list_files            -> "Writable workspace is empty"
$SCIENCEDISCOVERY_SKILLS_DIR/structure-pocket-inspection
调用失败: run_shell          (mkdir -p /workspace/idea_tree && cat …)
Run stopped / Run cancelled
```

## What was ruled out

- **Not the sandbox.** The `run_shell` failure is a consequence of the cancellation, not its cause. The same command (`mkdir -p /workspace/idea_tree && echo ok && ls -la /workspace`) run standalone in a fresh session returns `status=succeeded`, exit 0, prints `ok`, and creates the directory.
- **Not the selector.** The passing run used the identical `getByRole('region', { name: 'Idea Tree 研究控制' })`.
- **Not the model endpoint.** Both runs used the same endpoint and model.

## Why it matters

The journey exists to prove that a live model starts an Idea Tree research **from the prompt itself** — `/idea-tree …` is deliberately not intercepted, so the agent has to call `create_idea_research` on its own (`apps/desktop/src/idea/command.ts`). That is exactly the step that intermittently does not happen. As a gate the case is unreliable at 1/2: it will fail PRs and nightly runs that have nothing wrong with them.

## Environment

WSL Ubuntu / linux-amd64; stack on the default `http://127.0.0.1:4310` with the repository-default data directory `.sciencediscovery-data` (`start-stack --mode local` reads the repository `.env`, which overrides an exported `SCIENCE_DISCOVERY_DATA_DIR`); real runner; bubblewrap 0.9.0; model `http://113.46.219.251:8080/v1` with `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017`; backend `legacy` (`start-stack.sh --no-jiuwenswarm`, because that checkout fails the jiuwenswarm patch check).

## What is not yet established

Whether this is a prompt-shaping problem, ordinary model variance at the planning step, or a product defect in how the agent picks tools. No code change is implied by this report; a pass rate over several runs and the failing run's transcript are the next evidence to collect.

## Version Information

- Task under test: the real-model L4 Idea Tree journey added by #1293 (`test/journey-idea-tree-real.spec.ts`).
- Test head: `a5f028cdad2a0a473b3c926704fc84f373f10d4f` (PR #1293), two runs on that same head.
- Product code under test: the Linux checkout in WSL, working tree synced to `main` on 2026-11-22 (the checkout's `.git` HEAD is stale because the tree is synced by tarball; the working tree is what ran).
- Desktop build 0.4.1 was **not** used for this reproduction.
- Model: `http://113.46.219.251:8080/v1` / `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017`.

closed_recent.author: HongyeZhou
closed_recent.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] The description below includes environment information and a minimal reproduction, so the report can be followed without further questions.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**Summary**

`Settings › Timeouts › Execution timeout` has no effect on an ordinary agent shell run. The panel says "The longest one code execution in the sandbox may take.", 5 seconds were saved, and `sleep 10; echo done` still ran to completion.

**Steps to reproduce**

1. Open `Settings › Timeouts`, set **Execution timeout** to `5` seconds, save (the row reports `Saved`).
2. Start a new session and ask the agent to run `sleep 10; echo done` in the sandbox.
3. The tool returns `done` with exit code 0 after ~18 s of wall time; nothing is interrupted.

![Execution timeout set to 5 seconds](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/66ec1a15-6f83-488d-a6bd-ee76a58f093c)

![The 10-second command completes under a 5-second limit](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d4f35b10-c721-40ce-b24d-dd5fbbecbef4)

**The value does reach the run**

The shell record the API persists for that execution carries `originalExecutionContext.executionTimeoutMs = 5000`, and the execution itself spans `2026-11-22T06:36:15.839Z → 2026-11-22T06:36:26.045Z` (10.2 s, `succeeded`). So this is not a settings-plumbing problem: the request was correctly bounded and the bound was dropped afterwards.

**Root cause**

`services/runner/src/server.ts:1027` overwrites the request's limit for every managed (non-direct) execution:

```ts
// A client's waiting deadline is not the process's lifetime, so managed
// executions run without one by default. An operator who explicitly set
// SCIENCE_AGENT_EXEC_TIMEOUT_MS still gets a lifetime bound; ...
if (!direct) execution.executionTimeoutMs = config.execTimeoutMs > 0 ? config.execTimeoutMs : 0;
```

`config.execTimeoutMs` comes only from the Runner's environment (`server.ts:340`, `SCIENCE_AGENT_EXEC_TIMEOUT_MS`), whose default is `0` (`services/runner/src/executor.ts:100`, "unlimited"). A Runner started without that variable logs `execution timeout: unlimited` and therefore forces every request to `0`.

The setting is not a client waiting deadline: it is the deployment's own limit. The API sends it as `executionTimeoutMs` from the system setting `runnerExecTimeoutMs` (`services/api/src/configuration/settings-catalog.ts:26`) at `services/api/src/runs/index.ts:1423` and `:1966`, and the desktop text describes exactly that meaning (`apps/desktop/src/text/en.ts:1581`).

**Impact**

- `pnpm install`, a model download or a long training loop runs to the end regardless of the configured limit — the one thing an operator sets to bound sandbox time does nothing.
- The localized timeout failure already exists (`runner_exec`: `apps/desktop/src/text/zh.ts:2090`, `Tool execution exceeded N seconds…`) but cannot be reached from this setting.
- A user who lowers the limit to stop runaway commands gets no feedback that their change had no effect.

**Suggested fix**

Treat both sides as limits and keep the stricter one (0 meaning unlimited on either side):

```ts
const requested = execution.executionTimeoutMs ?? 0;
const configured = config.execTimeoutMs;
execution.executionTimeoutMs = requested > 0 && configured > 0
  ? Math.min(requested, configured)
  : Math.max(requested, configured);
```

If the Runner-side variable is deliberately the only authority, then the settings panel must say so (or the field must stop being offered as editable) and the API should stop sending a value that is discarded. Either way, add a regression test where a managed execution is submitted with `executionTimeoutMs: 5000` and a `sleep 10` payload must be terminated — the existing executor tests around `services/runner/src/scientific-execution.test.ts` are the natural place.

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- Product: ScienceDiscovery `main` at `bbdbdd5c9e7d04de3ff1d33da52eb41b87d60c9a` (2026-11-21). API `127.0.0.1:4410`, Runner `127.0.0.1:4411` (started without `SCIENCE_AGENT_EXEC_TIMEOUT_MS`), desktop web surface `http://127.0.0.1:5174`.
- Host: Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS, Node.js 22.23.2, pnpm 11.1.2, bubblewrap sandbox (`bbdbdd5c`).
- Client: Playwright Chromium build 1228, 1600x1000 viewport, locale `zh-CN`.
- Runner startup banner for this instance: `execution timeout: unlimited`.

### Additional Information

- Found while fault-injecting an execution limit for scenario S-203 (fault recovery).
- Related but separate: #1300 (artifact version numbers without a uniqueness guard), #1299 (model connection test localization).

### Version Information

- Repository: `openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery`, branch `main`
- Commit: `bbdbdd5c9e7d04de3ff1d33da52eb41b87d60c9a` (2026-11-21)
- Desktop app package version: `0.0.0` (private workspace package)

closed_recent.author: HongyeZhou
closed_recent.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] The description below includes environment information and a minimal analysis, so the report can be followed without further questions.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**Summary**

An artifact version's number is taken from `artifact.currentVersion + 1` and pushed into the catalog with no uniqueness guard. Every later lookup by `(artifactId, version)` uses `.find()`, so two records sharing a number would not raise anything — the first match silently wins. Because the UI labels versions by number alone (`v3`), a duplicate would be indistinguishable to the user while the server returns whichever record it finds first.

**Why it is worth a guard, even though it is hard to reach**

Normal writes are already serialized: `store.ts:5791` assigns the number from `artifact.currentVersion`, there is no `await` between the base-version check and the push, and a stale base is rejected with `ARTIFACT_VERSION_CONFLICT`. So two ordinary writes cannot collide.

The paths that are *not* covered:

- Snapshot restore re-registers versions through the same call (`services/api/src/research-snapshots.ts:1267` passes `restorationIds`, and the number is still derived from the target artifact's `currentVersion`). Restoring into a project that already has an artifact with the same `logicalName` is exactly the case where two writers describe the same artifact.
- More than one API process opening the same `catalog_state` row. The whole catalog is one JSON document (`store.ts:1547`), so SQLite cannot be asked for a unique index on `(artifactId, version)` — the guard has to be in code.
- Any future importer that copies versions verbatim instead of appending.

**What a duplicate does to the rest of the system**

- `apps/desktop/src/app/artifact-labels.ts:56` — `isNewer` falls back to `createdAt` when the numbers are equal, so ordering is only as good as the timestamps; the "current version" the list shows can be the older content.
- `services/api/src/artifacts/materialize.ts:18` — `listProjectArtifactVersions(...).find(v => v.version === input.version)` returns the first match, so restoring "version 3" can write the other version 3's bytes into the workspace.
- `services/api/src/artifacts/index.ts:260` — dependency resolution does the same by number, so provenance could bind to the wrong record.
- `store.ts:5638` (`latestReportVersion`) sorts by number and takes `[0]`.

None of these raise; the wrong bytes just come back.

**What I tried, and did not reproduce** (`zh-CN`, desktop web surface)

1. Same session, same path rewritten twice → `v1`/`v2`/`v3`, no duplicates.
2. Two subagents told to append to the same `/workspace/report.md` simultaneously → one new `v3` containing both appends (a second attempt had them create `report-A.md` / `report-B.md` instead).

So this is not reachable through the UI today; it is a missing invariant, not a live user-facing bug.

**Suggested fix** (chosen by the reporter: enforce uniqueness server-side)

1. Allocate the number from the catalog rather than from a field that can drift:
   ```ts
   const next = Math.max(0, ...this.catalog.artifactVersions
     .filter((v) => v.artifactId === artifact.id)
     .map((v) => v.version)) + 1;
   ```
2. Before `this.catalog.artifactVersions.push(version)` (`store.ts:5801`), reject the write if that `(artifactId, next)` already exists — `ARTIFACT_VERSION_DUPLICATE`, same shape as the existing `ARTIFACT_VERSION_CONFLICT`.
3. On load (`store.ts:1370`, where the catalog is already re-validated and `currentVersion` is recomputed at `store.ts:5833`), detect duplicates once and make them unambiguous before serving — renumbering by `createdAt` keeps every record reachable; a hard failure keeps the data pristine but stops the service.
4. A regression test for 1–2 next to `store.test.ts:3585` (where "server forces auto-increment" is already asserted).

Step 3 is the one judgement call: renumber silently, or refuse to load until a human looks. Either way the check should exist; the alternative — today's behaviour — is a wrong file restored with no trace.

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- Product: ScienceDiscovery, `main` at `bbdbdd5c9e7d04de3ff1d33da52eb41b87d60c9a` (2026-11-21); API on `127.0.0.1:4410`, runner on `127.0.0.1:4411`, desktop web surface on `http://127.0.0.1:5174`.
- Host: Ubuntu 22.04.5 LTS, Node.js 22.23.2, pnpm 11.1.2.
- Browser for the reproduction attempts: Playwright's Chromium build 1228 (headless), 1500x950, locale `zh-CN`.
- No screenshot: the defect is in storage/lookup, and the interface would only show its consequence.

### Additional Information

- Found while walking the artifact feature area (D7-03 版本切换): the picker offers `v3`/`v2`/`v1` with no other identifier, which is what makes a duplicate invisible rather than confusing-but-solvable.
- Related, separate: the panel/width and run-failure issues are #1296 and #1292; this one touches neither.

### Version Information

- Repository: `openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery`, branch `main`
- Commit: `bbdbdd5c9e7d04de3ff1d33da52eb41b87d60c9a` (2026-11-21)
- Desktop app package version: `0.0.0` (private workspace package)

closed_recent.author: HongyeZhou
closed_recent.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] The description below includes environment information and a minimal reproduction, so the issue can be reproduced without further questions.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**Summary**

In the desktop client, collapsing the left sidebar is not remembered. After a page refresh the sidebar is open again and the conversation area loses the width the user just recovered.

**Steps to reproduce** (1500x950 viewport, `zh-CN`)

1. Open the desktop client.
2. Click the collapse control at the top-left of the sidebar (`aria-label="收起侧栏"`).
   - Observed: the sidebar is removed and the main area grows from 1134 px to 1430 px. The control becomes `显示侧栏`.
3. Refresh the page (F5).
   - Expected: the sidebar stays collapsed, exactly like the right-hand workspace panel keeps its state.
   - Observed: the sidebar is open again and the main area shrinks back to 1134 px.

**Reproducibility**

3 out of 3 attempts, each ending with a refresh. Also reproduced by hand in the same build.

**Why this matters**

The only reason to collapse this column is to give the conversation more width. Users who work that way have to collapse it again after every refresh or restart, while the workspace panel on the right already remembers its state — the two panes behave inconsistently.

**Root cause pointer**

- `apps/desktop/src/App.tsx:146` — `const [sidebarOpen, setSidebarOpen] = useState(true);` is in-memory only; nothing reads a stored value when the app starts.
- The right panel is persisted for comparison: `apps/desktop/src/App.tsx:361` calls `writeStoredFlag(localStorage, RIGHT_PANEL_STORAGE_KEY, workspaceOpen)`, with the key defined at `apps/desktop/src/state/storage.ts:43`.
- There is no equivalent storage key for the left sidebar.

**Suggested fix**

Add a namespaced key next to `RIGHT_PANEL_STORAGE_KEY` (for example `${CURRENT_PREFIX}-desktop:sidebar`), initialize `sidebarOpen` from `readStoredFlag`, and write it wherever `setSidebarOpen` runs — the same pattern the workspace panel already uses. Keep the existing rule that expanding the sidebar also steps the panel aside.

### Detailed Environment Information Description

## English

### Background Description

The legacy Web UI lets users create a custom Specialist. Desktop **Settings → Specialists** can edit and delete custom Specialists and toggle built-in ones, but it has no create action. Users have to switch to the legacy UI to set up a new role. The Desktop form and API client already support creation.

### Design Ideas

- Restore **＋ Add specialist** in the Settings page header. Keep it available when there are no Specialists. Use separate create and edit states and reuse the existing `SettingsModal` and `SpecialistForm`; opening create always starts a fresh draft.
- Start with blank name, description and instructions, **Native** runtime and **Full access** (inherit abilities under existing permissions). Keep the current runtime options and skill/connector picker. Require a non-blank value for all three text fields, retain the Desktop name cap of 80, and align the description and instructions limits with the API (500 and 20,000 characters). Update the shared form’s EN/ZH labels and counters accordingly.
- While saving, block repeat submissions. On success, close the dialog and reload the list. On failure, keep the dialog and draft open and show the error so the user can retry. The new Specialist can be selected in a session through the existing selector; creation does not change the current selection.
- This issue restores manual creation in Settings. It does not restore the composer shortcut or change runtime setup, credential handling, or permissions.

### Involved Public APIs

Reuse `POST /api/specialists` through `createSpecialist` and `GET /api/specialists` through `listSpecialists`. Use the existing create contract and server-side validation, including case-insensitive duplicate-name handling. The default draft sends `runtime: { kind: "native" }` and empty `enabledSkillIds` and `connectorIds`.

### Test Design and Test Plan

Extend `apps/desktop/e2e/settings-interactions.spec.ts`: open from empty and populated lists; check cancel/reopen and the default POST payload; exercise runtime/capability selection and save failure followed by retry. Rerun the existing edit, delete, and built-in toggle scenarios. Verify the saved role appears in the session selector on its next open.

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **Add specialist** opens a blank, localized form from empty and populated lists. Canceling makes no write; reopening restores the defaults.
- [ ] Blank required fields cannot be submitted. A valid form creates exactly one Specialist, closes on success, and shows the new row without reloading the app.
- [ ] A duplicate name or failed POST leaves the draft and selected abilities intact, shows an error, and allows retry. The current session's selection and built-in Specialist controls are unchanged.
- [ ] Desktop Specialist settings tests pass. From the repository root, run `apps/desktop/e2e/node_modules/.bin/playwright test --config apps/desktop/e2e/playwright.config.ts settings-interactions.spec.ts --grep "专家"`.

### Additional Information

See [Create and use custom Specialists, §2–3](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/blob/main/docs/en/advanced-setup/configure-specialists.md#2-create-the-role), the [legacy Web create flow](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/blob/main/apps/web/src/Orchestration.tsx), and the [Desktop settings page](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/blob/main/apps/desktop/src/views/settings/system/Specialists.tsx) / [shared form](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/blob/main/apps/desktop/src/views/settings/system/SpecialistForm.tsx). See also #1178 for the parallel MCP settings change.

### Current Desktop UI on `main`

On this revision, users can edit or delete existing custom Specialists and toggle built-in Specialists. The screenshot uses sample records. [Source commit `c4315cf5d`](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/commit/c4315cf5d8ab76116cd3983f7a9eae2c529f1887)

![Current Desktop Specialists settings on main, English](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wyhohyw/sciencediscovery/2747db2733fb14928df04eaf13ef0e12c2332cf2/issue-assets/desktop-add-specialist/main-specialists-en.png)

### Desktop Mockup

Left: the action in **Settings → Specialists**. Right: a fresh create dialog with its default values.

![Desktop Specialists settings and the Add specialist dialog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wyhohyw/sciencediscovery/98a7fd75fc428935ad683efdb4443303f0be7b4c/issue-assets/desktop-add-specialist/add-specialist-en.png)

---

## 中文

### 背景

旧版 Web UI 可以新建自定义 Specialist。新版桌面端「设置 → 专家」可以编辑、删除已有的自定义专家，也可以启停内置专家，但缺少新建入口。用户需要切回旧版 Web UI 才能创建新角色。桌面端现有表单和 API 客户端已经支持创建。

### 设计方案

- 在「专家」页头恢复「＋ 新增专家」，列表为空时也可使用。区分新建和编辑状态，复用现有 `SettingsModal` 与 `SpecialistForm`；每次新建都从空白表单开始。
- 名称、描述、指令默认留空，运行时默认「原生」，能力默认「完全访问」（按现有权限继承主智能体的能力）。保留现有运行时选项及技能、连接器选择器。三个文本字段去掉首尾空白后均必填；保留名称 80 字符的桌面端上限，把描述和指令的上限改为 API 支持的 500 和 20,000 字符，并同步中英文必填提示与计数。
- 保存期间防止重复提交；成功后关闭弹窗并刷新列表；失败时保留草稿和能力选择，显示错误并允许重试。新专家可通过现有会话选择器选用，创建时不自动切换当前会话的专家。
- 本期只恢复设置页手动新增。聊天输入区不恢复新建快捷入口，运行时安装、凭据与权限机制沿用现状。

### 涉及的公开 API

复用 `createSpecialist` 调用 `POST /api/specialists`，通过 `listSpecialists` 调用 `GET /api/specialists` 刷新列表。继续使用服务端校验和持久化，包括名称不区分大小写的判重。使用默认配置保存时，提交 `runtime: { kind: "native" }` 和空的 `enabledSkillIds`、`connectorIds`。

### 测试方案

在 `apps/desktop/e2e/settings-interactions.spec.ts` 补充新增用例，覆盖空列表和已有列表的入口、取消后重开、默认创建请求、运行时和能力配置、保存失败后重试。复跑编辑、删除和内置专家启停用例，验证下次打开会话专家选择器时可以看到新角色。

### 验收标准

- [ ] 空列表和已有列表都能打开中英文新增表单；取消不写入数据，重开恢复默认值。
- [ ] 必填项为空时无法提交；合法配置只创建一条记录，成功后关闭弹窗，无需重新加载应用即可看到新专家。
- [ ] 重名或请求失败后保留输入和能力选择，显示错误并允许重试；当前会话选择及内置专家控制不受影响。
- [ ] 桌面端专家设置浏览器用例通过。仓库根目录运行 `apps/desktop/e2e/node_modules/.bin/playwright test --config apps/desktop/e2e/playwright.config.ts settings-interactions.spec.ts --grep "专家"`。

### 参考资料

参考[创建与使用自定义 Specialist：创建角色与会话验证](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/blob/main/docs/zh/advanced-setup/configure-specialists.md#2-创建角色)、[旧版 Web 新增流程](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/blob/main/apps/web/src/Orchestration.tsx)及[桌面端专家设置页](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/blob/main/apps/desktop/src/views/settings/system/Specialists.tsx) / [现有共用表单](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/blob/main/apps/desktop/src/views/settings/system/SpecialistForm.tsx)。同类设置页需求见 #1178。

### 当前 `main` 分支的桌面界面

这一版可以编辑或删除已有的自定义专家，也可以启停内置专家。截图中的专家为示例数据。[源码提交 `c4315cf5d`](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/commit/c4315cf5d8ab76116cd3983f7a9eae2c529f1887)

![当前 main 分支的桌面端专家设置页，中文版](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wyhohyw/sciencediscovery/2747db2733fb14928df04eaf13ef0e12c2332cf2/issue-assets/desktop-add-specialist/main-specialists-zh.png)

### 桌面端效果图

左侧展示「设置 → 专家」页头的新增入口；右侧展示新建弹窗的默认状态。

![桌面端专家设置页与新增专家弹窗](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wyhohyw/sciencediscovery/98a7fd75fc428935ad683efdb4443303f0be7b4c/issue-assets/desktop-add-specialist/add-specialist-zh.png)

### PR #1226 的新增专家弹窗

名称（最多 80 字符）、描述（最多 500 字符）和指令（最多 20,000 字符）均必填。运行时默认「原生」，选择外部运行时后可选填模型。能力默认「完全访问」，也可以指定技能和连接器。

![新增专家弹窗的完整默认状态](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wyhohyw/sciencediscovery/a0ff7640254a637a1ecd43e59a374c576246ebce/issue-assets/desktop-add-specialist/pr1226-add-specialist-dialog.png)

截图取自提交 `c04971d66`。[PR #1226](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/pull/1226)

### Prompt composition update / 提示词拼装调整

Agreed on 2026-11-21. Extract platform tool, permission, workspace, and artifact rules into `BASE_WORKSPACE_SYSTEM_PROMPT`. A selected Specialist uses that base followed by its description and instructions. The default science-analysis role and general workflow apply to ordinary sessions. Validate the final SD prompt on the native Agent and JiuwenSwarm adapter paths. Implementation and regression results are recorded in [PR #1226](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/pull/1226).

2026-11-21 确认：将平台工具、权限、工作区与产物规则提取到 `BASE_WORKSPACE_SYSTEM_PROMPT`。选择 Specialist 时使用该基础规则，再加入专家描述和指令；普通会话使用默认科研角色和通用分析流程。测试检查原生 Agent 与 JiuwenSwarm 适配器实际收到的 SD 提示词。实现与回归结果见 [PR #1226](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/pull/1226)。

### 🚀 Background Description

在输入框敲 `/idea-tree-team` 现在不会弹出任何参数卡片。它只是被识别：`apps/desktop/src/idea/command.ts:22` 列出 `/idea-tree-team` 与 `/idea-tree`，`App.tsx:762-774` 记下「等一个研究出现」（`awaitingIdea`），随后**照常当作消息发给 agent**（`:775`）。所以用户只能吃全局设置里的默认参数。

用户要求：发送 `/idea-tree-team` 时也弹出与上一条 feature 相同的参数卡片。

### Design Ideas

在发送路径上先拦住命令草稿：命中 `isIdeaTreeCommand` 时打开参数卡片，卡片确认后再把命令作为消息发出（与 `evolveCommandGoal` 分支 `App.tsx:753-761` 同构）。

注意不能破坏现有语义：`apps/desktop/src/idea/command.ts:26-29` 的注释明确「命令不被拦截，必须作为消息发给 agent 去收集证据」。所以这里要区分两件事——**先弹卡片**（UI），**命令仍然以消息发出**（行为）。取消卡片时不发送、草稿保留。

### Involved Public APIs

无新增接口。若参数随命令下发，命令格式会变，需在该 issue 的实现里写明。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

Composer 发送路径、`isIdeaTreeCommand`、Idea Tree 面板的 `awaitingIdea` 逻辑、以及上一条 feature 里的参数卡片（同一组件）。

### Test Design and Test Plan

- 草稿为 `/idea-tree-team` 时按发送 → 先弹卡片，且此时没有发出消息；
- 卡片确认 → 命令作为消息发出，`awaitingIdea` 行为与现在一致（研究出现后面板自动打开）；
- 卡片取消 → 不发消息、草稿保留；
- `/idea-tree` 与 `/idea-tree-team` 行为一致。

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] 输入 `/idea-tree-team` 并按发送时，弹出参数卡片而不是立即发消息
- [ ] 确认后命令仍以消息形式发出，研究出现后自动打开面板的行为不变
- [ ] 取消卡片不发送消息，草稿仍在输入框
- [ ] `/idea-tree` 与 `/idea-tree-team` 表现一致
- Command that must pass: `pnpm --dir application test`

### Additional Information

依赖「idea-tree 参数卡片」这一条 feature 先落地。

### 🚀 Background Description

输入框设置菜单（`apps/desktop/src/views/Composer.tsx:358-375`，行文本 `TEXT.composer.evolveExperiment`「程序演进实验」）目前只有一个动作行：点击后打开 `EvolveCreateDialog`（`App.tsx:1320`），确认后把参数变成 token 写回输入框（`:1341-1342`）。

Idea Tree 没有对应入口。它的参数只能在全局设置里改：`services/api/src/configuration/settings-catalog.ts:30` 定义 `idea_tree` 的字段为 `templateId / explorationIntensity / maxTokensPerCall / maxDepth / maxNodes / scoreDirection`，**作用域只有 `system`**。用户希望在「程序演进实验」下方增加一行「idea-tree」，点开同样的参数卡片，允许临时修改这些参数，并提供一个按钮询问是否覆盖全局设置。

### Design Ideas

- 菜单：在 evolve 行下方加一行同名样式（`session-menu-row`），新增 `onIdeaTree` 回调，由 `App.tsx` 与 `onEvolve`（`:1069`）并列提供。
- 卡片：复用 `apps/desktop/src/views/settings/IdeaTreeSettings.tsx`（现读 `GET /api/settings/idea-tree`）渲染字段。
- 提交分两条路：默认只作用于本次研究（临时），另给一个显式按钮「覆盖全局设置」写回 `PUT /api/settings/idea-tree`。
- 缺口要说清：`idea_tree` 现在只有 `system` scope，所以「临时」要么新增 session/project scope，要么把参数编进命令（Evolve 走的是后者，见 `evolveCommandGoal` 分支 `App.tsx:753-761`）。这是本 issue 需要定的主要取舍。

### Involved Public APIs

`GET/PUT /api/settings/idea-tree`（已存在）。若选会话级临时参数，则需要新增 settings scope 或命令参数格式，属公开行为变化，需在实现里写明。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

Composer 设置菜单、Evolve 对话框（并列入口）、设置页 Idea Tree 面板、`/idea-tree` 命令解析（`apps/desktop/src/idea/command.ts`）、settings-catalog 的 `idea_tree.configure` 能力。

### Test Design and Test Plan

- 菜单多出「idea-tree」一行，位于「程序演进实验」下方，点击打开卡片；
- 卡片初始值来自全局设置；
- 只改临时参数：不发消息、不写全局（断言没有 PUT `/api/settings/idea-tree`）；
- 点「覆盖全局设置」：写全局并回读一致；
- 取消卡片：草稿与全局设置都不变。

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] 菜单出现「idea-tree」一行，且位于「程序演进实验」下方
- [ ] 点击后打开与 Evolve 同形态的参数卡片，字段覆盖 `idea_tree` 的六个参数
- [ ] 提供「是否覆盖全局设置」的确认动作：确认才写全局，未确认时全局不变
- [ ] 关闭卡片不发送消息、不改全局
- Command that must pass: `pnpm --dir application test`

### Additional Information

UI 改动，需用户本人看截图确认。

Follow-up work split out of #717 (`fix(tools): bound model-facing execution and MCP results`) so that PR does not have to carry it. None of these blocks that PR. @moShangLouTou — GitHub refuses to assign this issue to you because your account has no write access to this repository; it is yours regardless.

## 1. The audit path has a depth cap but no total-size budget

`redactToolDetails` (`packages/tools/src/registry.ts`) deliberately drops the interactive size limits — that is the point of it, the durable record keeps complete safe metadata — and keeps only `MAX_AUDIT_DETAIL_DEPTH = 128`. Depth is bounded; total size is not. A result whose `details` are *wide* rather than deep — an MCP `records` array with many small records, for example — is written whole through `recordResult` into the durable trajectory and into the version recorder.

That is the same shape the interactive view already avoids with `MAX_DETAIL_TOTAL_CHARS`. Suggest a total-byte budget for the audit copy too, with an explicit `[audit-details truncated]`-style marker, so a reader can tell the difference between "the tool returned this" and "the recorder cut it".

## 2. `mcpModelResultView` copies the whole result twice

`mcpModelResultView` (`packages/workspace/src/mcp-result-view.ts`) runs `safeMcpValue` over the entire provider result to build a safe copy, and then `mcpRetainedContent` runs `JSON.stringify` over that copy whenever the projection is lossy. For a large result that is a full deep copy plus a full serialization on every MCP call.

Worth measuring against a realistically large provider result before deciding; if it shows up, a size gate on the retention serialization (retain only while the result is under some bound, with the existing "could not be stored" notice when it is not) would keep the recovery contract and remove the worst case.

## 3. Two journey assertions changed for reasons unrelated to this PR

- `test/journey-artifact-viewer-large-screen.spec.ts`: the readable-measure assertion moved from a fixed `760px` to `76ch` measured from the paragraph's computed font.
- `test/journey-model-connect-wizard.spec.ts`: the "高级配置" button assertion moved from `boundingBox().width > 50` to `scrollWidth <= clientWidth`.

Neither is needed by the tool-result contracts this PR introduces. If they were required to keep the suite stable, say so in a one-line note on #717; otherwise they belong in their own change.

closed_recent.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**What happens.** In the desktop app, **Settings › Skills**, the two bulk buttons — "Enable all" and "Disable all" — take about **5 seconds** to come back. While they run, both buttons and every per-skill switch on the page are disabled, so the page looks frozen and the list only repaints once the whole pass is over. A single skill's switch has the same shape, just shorter (about 1 s).

**Steps to reproduce.**

1. Start the desktop app on the JiuwenSwarm backend and open **Settings › Skills**. Here 31 skills are installed (17 ScienceDiscovery + 14 JiuwenSwarm built-in), all enabled.
2. Click **Disable all** (or **Enable all**).
3. Nothing changes for roughly 5 s: both bulk buttons and all switches stay disabled, no switch moves.
4. After the wait the list repaints with the new state.

**Expected.** A bulk action is a UI convenience over one setting; it should be acknowledged immediately (switches reflect the intent at once, failures rolled back), and the round trip should be one request, not one per skill.

**Actual.** About 5 s of a frozen settings page.

**Where the time goes** (read from `main`, 2026-11-20):

- `apps/desktop/src/views/settings/SkillsSettings.tsx:141-160` — `setAll` walks `[...page.skills, ...page.jiuwenSwarmSkills]` and **awaits one request per skill, sequentially** ("Each toggle is its own request"). With the 31 skills above that is 31 sequential PUTs.
- `apps/desktop/src/views/settings/SkillsSettings.tsx:262` and `:288` — every switch is `disabled={busy ...}`, and `rows.tsx:112-117` disables both bulk buttons, so the page is unusable for the whole pass.
- `services/api/src/http/index.ts:1991-2005` — the `skills-by-id` PUT calls `listJiuwenSwarmSkills()` **before** switching, so each of those requests pays a full skills listing first.
- `services/adapter/src/sciencediscovery_adapter/skills.py:165-171` — `set_enabled` invalidates the adapter's list cache on success, so the next PUT cannot reuse the previous listing (cache TTL 30 s, `:102-124`).
- `apps/desktop/src/app/use-loaded.ts:40-58` — after any write the page reloads its data instead of patching local state, so the switches only move after that reload, not when the write returns.

**Measured against the local API of the same desktop build** (31 skills installed):

| call | time |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /api/jiuwenswarm/skills` | 452–905 ms |
| `PUT /api/jiuwenswarm/skills/<name>` | 121–351 ms |
| `PUT /api/jiuwenswarm/skills-by-id/<id>` (includes the pre-listing) | 105–585 ms |

One request per skill in series, plus the list reload at the end, is exactly the observed several seconds; on a machine with a larger skill set it grows linearly.

**Suggested direction** (not a prescription):

- Add one batch write, e.g. `PUT /api/jiuwenswarm/skills/state` with `{ names: [...], enabled }` (or ids), applied in one adapter call, invalidating the list cache once.
- Or, without a new endpoint: bounded-concurrency PUTs plus a single list read at the end, instead of a serial loop and a full reload.
- Independently, the switches should flip on click and reconcile afterwards (revert on failure) rather than waiting for the server-confirmed reload.

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- Windows 11 Pro 25H2 (build 26200.9974), x64.
- ScienceDiscovery desktop app **0.4.0**, installed build (`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\ScienceDiscovery`).
- Agent backend: JiuwenSwarm, running inside the same app; API on `http://127.0.0.1:4410` (loopback).
- Skills installed at the time of the report: 17 ScienceDiscovery skills + 14 JiuwenSwarm built-in skills = 31, all enabled.
- Reproduces with no model configured and no session running — opening Settings › Skills and pressing a bulk button is enough.

### Additional Information

- The same per-request pattern makes a single switch feel slow too (toggle + full list reload ≈ 0.6–1.0 s); the bulk buttons are where it becomes several seconds.
- Related but different: #896 (closed) was about the global switches writing project settings; this report is only about the latency of the switches, not where the value is stored.
- Not a UI-style bug: no screenshot needed to see it, but I can record a screen capture if useful.

### Version Information

- Desktop app version: **0.4.0** (latest published release is `v0.4.0-rc1`).
- Source inspected: `main` on 2026-11-20 — `apps/desktop/src/views/settings/SkillsSettings.tsx`, `services/api/src/http/index.ts`, `services/adapter/src/sciencediscovery_adapter/skills.py`.

closed_recent.author: yuanzhou75
closed_recent.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

Idea Tree 设置里有一个「单次模型调用」上限（字段 `maxTokensPerCall`，默认 32768，范围 256–32768）。用户决定这个上限不再设置：代码实现与设置页面都要去掉，即单次模型调用不再有 max_tokens 上限（交给模型/服务默认）。

### Design Ideas

移除 `maxTokensPerCall`，但**保留** `maxTokens`（单次研究的总 token 预算，两者是不同概念）。改动点（main `92be8973`）：

- 桌面设置页 `apps/desktop/src/views/settings/IdeaTreeSettings.tsx`：`:103` 的 `maxTokensPerCall` 写入、`:185-194` 的「单次调用 token」输入行。
- 文案 `apps/desktop/src/text/zh.ts:1210-1211`（`tokensPerCall`/`tokensPerCallHint`）与 `en.ts:1190-1191`。
- Schema `packages/schema/src/runtime-settings.ts`：`:312`、`:336`（默认值）、`:347`、`:362`。
- 配置目录 `services/api/src/configuration/settings-catalog.ts:30`（`idea_tree` 字段列表）、`agent-metadata.ts:66`、`system-adapters.ts:120`、`discovery.ts:216`。
- 存储归一化 `services/api/src/store/settings.ts:562/:585/:612`（`normalizeIdeaTreeSettings`）。
- Python 引擎 `services/evolve/src/sciencediscovery_evolve/vendor/idea_tree/research.py:283`（`ceiling = maxTokensPerCall`，作为 `transport(..., ceiling, ...)` 的 max_tokens 上限）与 `research_service.py:35`（`Settings.maxTokensPerCall` 字段）。移除后单次调用不再传 max_tokens 上限。

### Involved Public APIs

`GET/PUT /api/settings/idea-tree` 的返回/写入 payload 去掉 `maxTokensPerCall`。属于公开接口变化，实现时确认旧值可被忽略、不破坏旧客户端。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

**边界（重要）**：本 issue 只动 Idea Tree 设置的 `maxTokensPerCall`。**不要动** Evolve 实验的 `budget.maxTokensPerCall`（`services/api/src/evolution/*`、`packages/schema/src/evolution.ts`），那是另一套 per-call ceiling，与本设置无关。`maxTokens`（单次研究总预算）保留。

### Test Design and Test Plan

- 设置页不再出现「单次调用 token」行，保存 payload 不含 `maxTokensPerCall`。
- 归一化与 schema 不接受/不返回该字段。
- Python 引擎在未配置该字段时仍能正常跑通一次 research（不再读取 `maxTokensPerCall`）。
- 存量设置文件里若还有 `maxTokensPerCall`，读取时被忽略、不报错。
- 相关测试同步删除对 `maxTokensPerCall` 的断言（`store/settings.test.ts`、`discovery.test.ts`、`system-adapters.integration.test.ts`、`test_idea_research.py:303`）。

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] 桌面设置页没有「单次调用 token」输入项
- [ ] `/api/settings/idea-tree` 的读写不再携带 `maxTokensPerCall`
- [ ] Idea Tree 引擎单次模型调用不再传 max_tokens 上限
- [ ] `maxTokens` 总预算行为不变
- [ ] Evolve 的 `budget.maxTokensPerCall` 不受影响
- Command that must pass: `pnpm --dir application test`、`pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/schema build`、services/api 与 services/evolve 相关测试

### Additional Information

UI 改动（设置页少了一行），需用户本人看截图确认。

closed_recent.body:
> Sub-task of #84.

### Scope

Split the two idea-tree routers out of evolve, with their own state directory, and expose them to the agent as MCP tools.

### Dependencies

**Prerequisites:**

- #87 Adapter core: auth, connection pool, run and event log, storage and proxy framework: reverse proxy framework
- #93 Skills and skill library: `skills/:id/deletion-impact` must check idea-tree references
- #97 Science toolset as MCP: agent-side tool convention
- #98 artifact / provenance / CAS service (including papers): research references artifacts

**Depended on by:**

- #102 evolve service

### Interface list

6 in total: standalone backend 6. **0 need wrapper adaptation (approximate mapping + adapter-implemented).**

| Method | Path | Handling | Target | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/sessions/:id/idea-tree/research` | standalone backend | idea-tree service /research/command |  |
| POST | `/api/sessions/:id/idea-tree/research` | standalone backend | idea-tree service | create/get/pause/continue/end/defaults; create also writes a chat message |
| GET | `/api/sessions/:id/idea-tree/research/:researchId/events` | standalone backend | idea-tree service /research/events | SSE |
| GET | `/api/sessions/:id/idea-tree/graph` | standalone backend | idea-tree service /command |  |
| GET | `/api/settings/idea-tree` | standalone backend | idea-tree service |  |
| PUT | `/api/settings/idea-tree` | standalone backend | idea-tree service |  |

### Non-interface tasks

- [ ] Split `idea_tree_service` and `research_service` out of the evolve service into a standalone service
- [ ] Research stream SSE pass-through; `create` also appends a chat message
- [ ] Wrap as MCP tools for the JiuwenSwarm agent
- [ ] Migrate the TS package (tool contract and runtime), removing the `python-client.ts` layer

### Acceptance

- [ ] Every interface row in the table above has an L1 contract diff case, or is explicitly marked “no migration needed”
- [ ] Involved events have an L2 golden trace
- [ ] Corresponding E2E cases, to be added once the list of 10 cases is settled
