recent.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

The desktop Evolve entry point lets a user choose PUCT/OpenEvolve and optionally provide a JSON candidate plus editable fields, but it has no dedicated controls for the search's total token budget, wall-clock budget or expansion budget. The run panel displays token/time consumption only after a run exists.

This prevents a user from directly choosing and verifying a bounded experiment before starting it. In a Windows PUCT run on 2026-11-26, the frozen run used 32 expansions, 4 workers, 600,000 total tokens and 7,200 seconds. These values could be inspected in the run record, but not configured in a desktop budget form.

Current source behavior:

- `DirectionDialog` confirms only the algorithm and optional candidate JSON/edit scope. Custom JSON fields belong to the candidate being evolved; adding a field named `maxTokens` there is not a search-budget setting.
- `BudgetBar` renders progress bars with no budget editor.
- `EvolveRunProposal` / `create_evolve_run` accept `expansions` and `workers`, so an agent can request them through conversation. They do not expose configurable total tokens or total seconds.
- `startProposedRun()` sets total tokens to 600,000 and total seconds to 7,200 using backend constants. The per-call ceiling is derived from algorithm/effective thinking mode.

Related: #1346 addresses range/interaction hints in the existing custom-parameter editor; #780 made the conversational checkpoint disclose a budget plan. This request is for an actual search-budget configuration surface and end-to-end parameter support, not another candidate JSON field or a prose-only plan.

### Design Ideas

Add a clearly labelled search-budget section to the Evolve setup/confirmation flow, separate from the candidate JSON editor:

- Total token cap, with units and validated bounds.
- Total elapsed-time cap, entered in minutes and stored in seconds.
- Maximum candidate expansions, labelled as expansions rather than an ambiguous total node count; state whether the baseline is excluded.
- An optional advanced concurrency setting, with the effective value shown before starting.
- Show the effective per-call token ceiling derived from the selected algorithm and thinking mode. At minimum this should be visible; if manual override is supported, validate it against existing model/algorithm constraints instead of silently changing it.

Display requested and effective values before confirmation, including limitations and concurrency-related budget exposure. Preserve current defaults for clients that omit overrides. Reject invalid values with field-specific messages, and explain any cross-field restriction before the run is created.

A minimal first implementation can be per-run; global defaults/session overrides are not required for this request. Keep the same budget readable in the frozen run and existing usage panel.

### Involved Public APIs

Extend the typed run proposal/tool and server validation with optional budget overrides, including total tokens and total seconds. Thread the confirmed values from the desktop submission through agent/tool invocation into the frozen `EvolveGoal.budget`; do not rely only on prompt wording for user-selected limits. Update `get_evolve_budget`/budget-plan calculation to describe those same effective limits. Existing clients and stored runs must remain compatible.

Do not add a write-only UI whose values are ignored by `proposal.ts` or permit arbitrary candidate JSON fields to override execution policy.

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

- `apps/web`: Evolve setup/confirmation, submission state and API types, localized validation copy, current budget display. The Electron shell loads this UI.
- `packages/schema`, `packages/evolve`: proposal/budget types and tool contracts.
- `services/api`: proposal validation, shared budget plan, preflight, persistence and orchestrator enforcement.
- Both PUCT and OpenEvolve share the budget contract; defaults for either algorithm must remain valid.

### Test Design and Test Plan

- Focused UI checks: enter valid limits and see effective values before confirmation; reject zero, negative, nonfinite, malformed and out-of-range values; preserve edits when navigating the setup flow; verify keyboard access and English/Chinese labels.
- A submission-to-persisted-run integration check: user-selected limits equal the tool request, effective plan and saved run budget; omitted overrides retain current defaults.
- Verify per-call ceilings and concurrency/expansion constraints with the same validation used by preflight. Do not silently coerce incompatible values.
- Add focused API/tool tests for new optional fields and backward compatibility; run typechecks for the affected packages.

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Before starting an Evolve run, desktop users can set total tokens, total duration and maximum expansions in dedicated controls with units and bounds.
- [ ] Candidate JSON/edit scope is visibly separate from search configuration.
- [ ] Confirmation displays the effective budget and derived per-call token ceiling; invalid combinations cannot silently start with different limits.
- [ ] The user's confirmed limits reach the stored run and enforcement path without being replaced by backend constants or an agent's unrelated choice.
- [ ] Omitted overrides preserve current defaults and existing runs still load.
- [ ] Targeted UI/API/tool tests and affected package typechecks pass. Relevant typecheck commands include `pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/web typecheck`, `pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/api typecheck`, and `pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/evolve typecheck`.

### Additional Information

This request was established by inspecting the desktop/web implementation and backend proposal path; no new desktop/browser journey was run for this report. Budget-exhaustion finalization and cancellation diagnostics are tracked separately in #1435.

Checked against local `36476b0ea302b6de3897154f83c3c7c87dc6ec89` and fetched upstream main `3a00fd822e7cd88f0044e7c2e562febb8eb06dd1`; the relevant setup, budget display and proposal budget defaults remain unchanged.

- [Evolve confirmation dialog](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/blob/3a00fd822e7cd88f0044e7c2e562febb8eb06dd1/apps/web/src/evolve/DirectionDialog.tsx#L41-L56)
- [Read-only budget display](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/blob/3a00fd822e7cd88f0044e7c2e562febb8eb06dd1/apps/web/src/evolve/BudgetBar.tsx#L40-L65)
- [Backend budget defaults](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/blob/3a00fd822e7cd88f0044e7c2e562febb8eb06dd1/services/api/src/evolution/call-budget.ts#L60-L70)
- [Frozen proposal budget](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/blob/3a00fd822e7cd88f0044e7c2e562febb8eb06dd1/services/api/src/evolution/proposal.ts#L563-L575)

recent.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

While a turn is running the permission pill is disabled, so its mode cannot be changed. An evolve design started in 请求批准 (`ask_for_dangerous`) mode therefore stops at its first shell command, and the UI gives no sign that it is waiting for an approval — it keeps showing 正在规划下一步. In my run the design sat like that for **3 hours 31 minutes** until I cancelled the turn.

Steps:
1. New session in the desktop app; leave the permission pill at 请求批准.
2. Type `/evolve-design --algorithm openevolve <task>` and send.
3. The design writes an evaluator, then asks for `Run a shell script in the Session workspace`.
4. Try to switch to 完全访问 while it waits: the pill is `disabled`, `title="这一轮跑完才能切换权限"`.

Observed:
- `GET /api/permission-requests?status=pending` shows the request (`createdAt 2026-11-23T02:11:52.696Z`, summary `Run a shell script in the Session workspace`), still `pending` after 3.5 h.
- The composer shows only 正在规划下一步 and the disabled pill; nothing points at the pending approval, and there is no link or badge to open it.
- Cancelling the turn (`POST /api/sessions/<id>/run/cancel` → 202) then loses the half-written design; the only way forward is to start over with 完全访问.

Expected, any of:
- allow switching the permission mode for subsequent tool calls of the running turn (or offer "allow and switch to 完全访问" on the approval itself), or
- at minimum surface the pending approval prominently (badge/HUD with a link) instead of a passive 正在规划下一步, and keep the request reachable after the turn is cancelled.

Code pointers:
- `apps/desktop/src/views/Composer.tsx:1113` — `title={running ? TEXT.composer.permissionLocked : TEXT.composer.permissionMode}` and the same `running` flag disables the button.
- `apps/desktop/src/text/zh.ts:259` — `permissionLocked: "这一轮跑完才能切换权限"`.

Note: the same lock makes the *documented* evolve workflow fragile, because evolve needs shell runs and the documented setup is to switch to 完全访问 **before** starting the design; if the user forgets, the only feedback is a silent stall.

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- Product: ScienceDiscovery desktop app (Electron shell around the web UI), Chinese locale `zh-CN`, 1500×950.
- Commit: `a8573558f8c372854079a65906171b3a543b6fb7` (main, 2026-11-22), API `4410` / runner `4411` / evolve sidecar `17676`.
- Session: `fb32e61f-59e3-46d9-a325-2083b3ed3bc2` (the stalled design), pending request id `27b4ceee-b80f-4bd1-9734-f779b24094b3`.
- Evolve runtime `{"state":"ready","canInitialize":false,"sandbox":"bwrap"}`; model Ark DeepSeek.
- Host: Ubuntu 22.04.5, Chromium 1228 + Playwright 1.61.1.

### Additional Information

- Evidence: `~/sd-test/evidence/s205/H1-dialog-auto.png` (the dialog before sending), `J1-dialog.png` (the same dialog after switching to 完全访问 — this path works), plus the pending-request JSON quoted above.
- Workaround used: approve via `POST /api/permission-requests/<id>/decision {"decision":"allow_matching"}` — that resolves it, but the UI never offered it.
- The same applies to any long tool-using turn, not only evolve: the turn cannot be re-scoped mid-flight, so the user must cancel and restart.

### Version Information

- `a8573558f8c372854079a65906171b3a543b6fb7` (main branch, 2026-11-22T15:52:52Z).

recent.body: ### Checklist - [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help. - [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version. - [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which may reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed. ### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem **Summary.** In `技能 › 添加技能 › 上传技能`, dropping a skill ZIP downloaded from a skills repository (`skills-main.zip`, 4 271 KB) and pressing `导入` fails with the bare English sentence `Skill archive exceeds 500 entries`. The pane stays Chinese, that number appears nowhere else in the product, and nothing says the archive is a multi-skill bundle the importer never accepts — or that `Git` import is the route that does. **Steps to reproduce** 1. Open `技能 › 添加技能 › 上传技能`. 2. Drag `skills-main.zip` (`Code → Download ZIP` of a skills repository that holds several skills) onto `拖到这里，或点击选择文件`. 3. Press `导入`. **Observed** The file row shows `skills-main.zip · 4271 KB`, `导入` is enabled, the request fails immediately, and the only feedback is a red `Skill archive exceeds 500 entries` under the buttons. The archive stays selected and nothing else on the pane changes. _Screenshot: `skill-upload-500-entries.png`, attached at the end of this report._ **What the message means.** - The importer accepts exactly one skill package per archive. `POST /api/skills/import` → `skillCatalog.import(filename, bytes)` → `inspectZip` refuses the archive before extraction when its central directory holds more than `SKILL_LIMITS.files` records ([packages/specialist/src/skills.ts:90-97](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/blob/main/packages/specialist/src/skills.ts#L90-L97), `inspectZip` at [:895-907](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/blob/main/packages/specialist/src/skills.ts#L895-L907)): ```ts // packages/specialist/src/skills.ts export const SKILL_LIMITS = { archiveBytes: 25 * 1024 * 1024, extractedBytes: 50 * 1024 * 1024, files: 500, resourceBytes: 10 * 1024 * 1024, runtimeTextBytes: 1024 * 1024, skillMarkdownBytes: 512 * 1024, } as const; // inspectZip if (entries > SKILL_LIMITS.files) throw payloadTooLarge(`Skill archive exceeds ${SKILL_LIMITS.files} entries`); ``` - `entries` is the total central-directory record count, so `scripts/` and `references/` directory records count too. A `Download ZIP` of a skills repository passes 500 long before anything is unpacked. - The same number is enforced again for in-memory packages as `Skill package exceeds 500 files` ([skills.ts:750](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/blob/main/packages/specialist/src/skills.ts#L750)), so relaxing only the ZIP check changes nothing. - A repository-wide archive would fail anyway one step later: `loadPackage` requires `SKILL.md` at the archive root — `Skill package must contain SKILL.md at its root` ([skills.ts:766](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/blob/main/packages/specialist/src/skills.ts#L766)). Nothing tells the reader that either. - The client prints the server sentence verbatim — `messageOf()` returns `reason.message` and `importFile` puts it in `setFailure` ([SkillUploadView.tsx:31-33](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/blob/main/apps/desktop/src/views/settings/SkillUploadView.tsx#L31-L33), [:62-77](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/blob/main/apps/desktop/src/views/settings/SkillUploadView.tsx#L62-L77)) — so a Chinese pane shows an untranslated internal limit, with no entry count, no offending path, and no next step. **Expected.** The failure should name the real problem and the remedy: - If the archive has no root `SKILL.md`, say so, and say that one ZIP is one skill package; a whole repository is imported by URL through `Git`, which already inspects a repository, lists the skills it finds and lets the reader pick (`POST /api/skills/import-git/inspect`, `POST /api/skills/import-git/review`, `POST /api/skills/import-git`). - If the entry cap is the problem, report it in the interface language with the actual count beside the cap (`N 个条目，上限 500`), plus the same "one package per archive / use Git" hint. - `docs/zh/advanced-setup/configure-skills.md` §2 says only "选择 `SKILL.md` 或包含技能包的 ZIP"; neither the 500-entry / 500-file / 25 MiB limits nor "one package per archive" are documented anywhere. **Impact.** The documented local-file route is the obvious way to install a skill collection found on GitHub, and it dead-ends: the reader is handed a number the UI never showed, in English, with no indication that the archive is out of scope and that Git import would work. ### Detailed Environment Information Description - ScienceDiscovery client, Windows, 2026-11-15 build (as reported by the reporter). - Input: `skills-main.zip`, 4 271 KB, produced by `Code → Download ZIP` on a skills repository — several skills inside, no `SKILL.md` at the archive root. ### Additional Information - The screenshot above is the upload pane right after pressing `导入`. - Not derived from a local build of the repository: the report is the client's own text. The code references are `main` @ `8bcb9ac` (2026-11-25), where the limits and the message are unchanged. - Same shape as #1415 — an English server sentence surfaced verbatim inside a Chinese pane instead of a message written for the reader. ### Version Information - `openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery`, client build of 2026-11-15; limits verified unchanged on `main` @ `8bcb9acc0bb619d11b7054138ffcea3be1e2d79c` (2026-11-25). ![上传技能导入报错 Skill archive exceeds 500 entries](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ce0c3b4d-358a-460e-8b0c-fc200a7594ff) 上传的技能压缩包也会出现在会话中

stale.author: hsliuustc0106
stale.body:
## Context

Since July 2026 an open-source "science workbench" category has formed, triggered by Anthropic's Claude Science launch (2026-06-30). Three direct open-source alternatives appeared the same week and are now at scale: [synthetic-sci/openscience](https://github.com/synthetic-sciences/openscience) (~3.6K★), [aipoch/open-science](https://github.com/aipoch/open-science) (~4.2K★), and [ai4s-research/open-science](https://github.com/ai4s-research/open-science) (~1.7K★). Having compared ScienceDiscovery against them (and against the autonomous-scientist systems: Sakana AI-Scientist, InternScience/InternAgent + MLEvolve), here is a strengths/gaps assessment in the hope it helps prioritization. Facts below are from public repo data collected 2026-09-15.

## Strengths (keep — and communicate)

1. **Sandbox-first security model.** Fail-closed Bubblewrap/Seatbelt execution, operator-scoped NPU chip passthrough, opt-in Broker with fixed entry points and `shell: false`. None of the three competitors communicates a default-isolation story; the highest-engagement technical question on a competitor's launch thread was literally *"are the skills executed within a secure, containerized sandbox by default, or does the user manage isolation?"* — this repo already answers that question, but almost nobody knows it does.
2. **Provenance depth.** CAS with pinned-asset drift rejection, review checks, cross-session/SubAgent citation chains. The strongest provenance story in the category.
3. **Search-camp RSI engine.** The evolve sidecar (flat-PUCT tree + OpenEvolve MAP-Elites, discriminability probe, explicit "no model training, no search-rule modification") is a clean, honest scope with a real cousin in [InternScience/MLEvolve](https://github.com/InternScience/MLEvolve) (#1 on MLE-Bench).
4. **Ascend NPU path.** 910B sandbox passthrough + allowlisted workloads (Protenix/MindScience) is unique in the category and extends machine-verifiable research to device-scale workloads.
5. **Engineering discipline beyond repo age.** Bilingual doc set, CI tiers (UT/ST/mocked E2E), self-documented limitations (e.g., Idea Tree scores are model judgments, not experimental evidence).

## Gaps (ordered by leverage)

1. **Installation/onboarding.** No binaries in Releases — #1 (open since 08-19, rated 1/5) is the only organic user feedback this repo has received, and it is someone who *could not install the product*. All three competitors ship desktop installers and a <10-minute quickstart. This pairs directly with the first-experience goal in #22.
2. **No community surface.** All merged PRs are bots; there are zero human external PRs. For comparison: aipoch merges 6+ human PRs/day; ai4s-research power users file bugs *and* land the fixes (e.g., their stall-guard for looping agents came from a user). A "good first issue" ladder + a contributor guide + weekly maintainer RFC triage would start the flywheel.
3. **Category invisibility + an unverifiable benchmark claim.** 58★ vs 1.7–4.2K for peers; one promotion event found (Sina Finance 2026-08-16) whose headline claim (BiomniBench-DA "业界SOTA") is dual-claimed by aipoch's README badge on the same benchmark. Without published methodology/splits, the claim reads as marketing and hurts credibility with scientists — either publish the eval or drop the superlative.
4. **Adoption levers validated by competitors, still missing here:** headless CLI / task API (repeated cross-repo demand — researchers want CI and agent-to-agent use, not only a GUI), model-provider onboarding (subscription reuse, connectivity-test friction), Windows parity.
5. **Cross-model skill consistency.** The single most-validated complaint in the category: *"one flag switches the model, not whether the skill actually works"* (prompts tuned on one model degrade on smaller/local models). A per-skill model-compatibility matrix or a cross-model smoke-test suite for the 300+ skills would directly differentiate.

## Suggested next steps

- [ ] Ship Linux binaries + a 10-minute quickstart (pairs with #22)
- [ ] Publish evolve/idea-tree efficiency metrics (per-node token cost, CAS reuse rate, surviving-node quality on an independent benchmark) — the pruning+reuse efficiency story is genuinely differentiating and no competitor tells it
- [ ] Benchmark-claim triage: methodology for BiomniBench-DA or remove the SOTA wording
- [ ] Community ladder: CONTRIBUTING good-first-issues + a maintainer-reserved RFC-triage day

Happy to help flesh any of these out.
stale.title: [Feedback] Strengths and gaps vs. the 2026 open-source science-workbench landscape

items.author: ink999107
items.body:
Fixes #1428.
Fixes #1442.

**Based on `main`.** #1378, which rewrote the upload pane these messages appear on, has merged. This branch is rebased onto `main`, and its diff is only the fixes below.

## The problem

### A refused archive

Dropping a repository-wide `skills-main.zip` on 技能 › 添加技能 › 上传技能 failed with the bare English sentence `Skill archive exceeds 500 entries`. The pane stayed Chinese, the number appeared nowhere else, and nothing said that one archive is one skill package — or that Git import is the route that accepts a whole repository.

### Packages that arrived but stayed switched off

Reviewing the install path found four ways an import could report success without leaving a usable skill:

1. An upload that imported but whose JiuwenSwarm switch-on failed still showed a success notice. The error was drawn only on the list, which the reader had not reached yet.
2. Git import swallowed the switch-on errors and cached the finished run per job, so the same job could not try again.
3. The background job lived only in renderer memory. A reload during the import lost it, while the API finished installing with every new package left switched off.
4. A page-2 inspection answer that arrived after the repository address changed was merged back into the cleared view. The box showed one repository while the rows, and the import request, belonged to another.

These are the four findings reported in #1442. Its finding 3 is treated as a lifecycle gap rather than a claim that a packaged window can refresh: the resume path is defence in depth for reloadable renderers, so an import interrupted by a renderer restart still finishes its switch-on step, and #1442 does not ask for a refresh journey.

**This is the PR meant to land.** #1432 (per-code errors, #1428 only) and #1452 (its own enable-outcome shape, #1442 only) cover the same ground. Once this PR merges they are redundant for their issues, and their contracts are not additive with this one: a refused import is one `SKILL_PACKAGE_REFUSED` code with `details.refusal`, and the switch-on result is the outcome kept in `git-skill-import-job.ts`.

## What changed

**API.** A refused import now answers with `code: "SKILL_PACKAGE_REFUSED"` and `details.refusal`, carrying the facts a localized surface needs instead of only English prose:

- `{ reason: "too-large", limit, actual, cap, path? }` for the entry cap, the file caps and the archive / extracted / per-file byte caps. The entry refusal carries the central-directory count the reader's ZIP actually had.
- `{ reason: "missing-root" | "several-roots" | "outside-root" }` for the package-shape refusals behind the one-package rule.

The HTTP status is unchanged (413 for size, 400 for shape), and `error` still carries the original sentence for logs and callers that show the server's own text. `SkillPackageRefusal` lives in `@sciencediscovery/schema` so the server and the desktop read the same shape.

**Desktop — the refused archive.** `SkillUploadView` writes the refusal in the pane's language from those facts — `压缩包里有 1200 个条目，上限是 500 个。` — and every refusal ends with the remedy: one archive is one package, and a repository is a 从 GitHub 导入 job that lists its skills first. The dialog's hint says the same before a file is dropped, so a repository ZIP is explained before it is tried.

**Desktop — the import's switch-on step.**

- `afterInstall` now returns why a switch-on failed. The upload dialog still closes onto the list, but the notice is the truth: a success toast only when the package is on, otherwise an error toast naming the package and the reason (the list alert keeps the reason too).
- The job store records which created packages stayed off and publishes that to the pane. The job's result then says how many are still off (`已导入 N 个技能，但 M 个未能启用`) and offers a retry that reruns the switch-on step. A failed run is shared with a pane that joins late instead of duplicated; only the explicit retry starts a second attempt. The failure also keeps the banner until it is dismissed, unlike the 10-second success notice. When the import itself also had failures, the two problems keep their own notice and retry: the import retry re-runs the failed subdirectories, and only the enable retry switches on the packages that did arrive.
- The job id is remembered in `sessionStorage`, and the app resumes it at startup (the Skills pane tries again when it mounts). A reload during the import still polls the API and still runs the switch-on step when the job ends.
- Inspections and pages carry a generation. Changing the address, ref or subdirectory invalidates in-flight answers, so a page from a repository the reader has left cannot repopulate the list, and the import target always matches what the box shows.

**Docs.** `docs/{zh,en}/advanced-setup/configure-skills.md` §2 now lists the one-package rule, the package-root `SKILL.md` requirement (the ZIP's root, or the single top-level directory the ZIP wraps — whose name must match the skill's `name`), the 500-entry / 500-file caps and the 25 MiB / 50 MiB byte limits, and says a `Code → Download ZIP` archive of a multi-skill repository must go through Git import.

## Validation

- `pnpm typecheck` — pass, all packages plus `tsconfig.tests.json`.
- `packages/specialist` — 19 passed / 0 failed, including four new refusals that assert the structured facts (501 entries → `actual: 501, cap: 500`; repository ZIP → `missing-root`; an archive of loose files → `missing-root`; two top-level dirs → `several-roots`).
- `services/api` `skills.test.ts` and `server.test.ts` — pass, including the new route test that asserts the 413 body is `SKILL_PACKAGE_REFUSED` with `{ actual: 501, cap: 500, limit: "entries" }` and that the sub-cap repository ZIP is a 400 `missing-root`.
- `apps/desktop` — 1626 passed / 0 failed. New checks cover the refusal count and the Git route in the dialog's language, an upload whose switch-on fails reporting an error instead of success, a failed Git switch-on being reported and retryable, a partial import whose switch-on also failed still offering the enable retry, a reloaded window resuming the job and finishing the switch-on step, a failed resume not freezing an import that started meanwhile, and a stale page never landing after the repository changes.
- `pnpm docs:lint` — 0 issues.

Release category: release:fix

User impact: a refused skill upload now says what was wrong in the interface language, with the actual count, and names Git import for a whole repository. A Git import whose new packages could not be switched on now says so, can retry, and survives a reload.

Compatibility and migration: none; the new error code and details are additive, the statuses are unchanged, and the remembered job id is a per-window `sessionStorage` entry that is cleared when the job is dismissed or forgotten.

A budget stop arrived as an ordinary stop: cancelled calls read "the model returned an empty reply", cancelled candidates were filed `candidate-failed`, the held-out evaluation said "the best candidate failed", the terminal event said `stopReason: max_iters` and the winner's score was lost.

**Changes**
- `cancellation.py`: `StopGate` stays the `should_stop` predicate and carries `cause`/`reason` (thread-local relaxation for one bounded evaluation); domains mark stopped evaluations; unknown cause = user stop.
- `POST /runs/{id}/stop` takes optional `{cause, reason}` (`budget`, `wall_clock`, `user`; body-less = user), recorded before the flag is set; the terminal event keeps that cause instead of `max_iters`.
- `completion` reports abandonment via `on_cancelled`, never an empty reply; stopped evaluations get the new `cancelled` category (schema, web/desktop verdict, labels), while a recorded provider failure or veto keeps its own label.
- `finish()`: a budget stop gets one bounded held-out evaluation, the stop lifted on that thread only (one retry if the stop lands mid-evaluation); user/wall-clock stops run none; otherwise "not evaluated: cancelled by <reason>". "the best candidate failed" only when an evaluation really ran and failed.

**Verified**
Focused evolve suites: 130 passed / 20 failed, the 20 are `@live` Bubblewrap `SandboxUnavailable`, identical at baseline (110 passed); full evolve 433/27 sandbox-only. API evolution tests 240 pass / 1 fail (clean-worktree guard), orchestrator 30/30; web 1420, desktop 1576, schema 37; `pnpm typecheck` exit 0.

**Acceptance** — cancellation (`..._cancelled_completion_...`, `..._cancelled_while_being_evaluated_...`), finalization (`..._still_scores_the_winner_...`, `..._retries_once_and_keeps_the_score`), prompt stop (`..._without_a_final_evaluation`, `orchestrator.test.ts`), true cause (`..._keeps_the_true_cause...`), empty reply (`..._empty_reply_...`).

**Limits** — `ci:*` preflight is `BUBBLEWRAP_UNAVAILABLE` here.

Closes #1435

### Tests

```
uv run --project services/evolve --locked --extra test pytest services/evolve/tests/test_completion.py services/evolve/tests/test_puct_engine.py services/evolve/tests/test_server.py -q
```

Reported by the agent; the platform did not rerun it.

## Changes
The footer permission pill was disabled while a turn was running, so the mode could not be changed once a run had started. It now stays usable: `Composer` no longer disables it, its title scopes the change to the tool calls still to come, and `PermissionFlyout` takes a `running` flag that prints a visible note in zh and en.

The note states what the server actually does: the switch applies to later tool calls; it stops this session's scientific kernels and shell sessions with their in-memory state; an executing tool finishes first and the switch then takes effect; only approvals the new policy covers are settled; a direct-on-machine request still asks separately; 仅允许一次 / Allow once releases just the current request.

**Scope.** Per the owner's decision in review 6072890126 this pull request is now only the mid-run switch. The composer's pending-approval notice, its styles, strings, tests and `App.tsx` wiring are gone, and so is the `hasReplayContent` change in `run-stream/replay.ts`. If a run blocked on an approval really does render an empty transcript on `main`, that belongs in its own pull request with its own reproduction.

## Visual evidence
Component-level renders of the real `Composer`, `Conversation` and `PermissionFlyout` with `apps/desktop/src/styles/index.css`, Chromium 156, 1440×900 at 2× (2880×1800). No browser journey: the mocked desktop entry cannot hold an SSE run open. Pinned to `__SHA__`:

![zh: permission flyout opened mid-run](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/__SHA__/docs/screenshots/1330/01-zh-permission-flyout.png)
![en: permission flyout opened mid-run](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/__SHA__/docs/screenshots/1330/02-en-permission-flyout.png)
![zh: state after switching to 完全访问 mid-run](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/__SHA__/docs/screenshots/1330/03-zh-after-switch.png)
![en: state after switching to Full access mid-run](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/__SHA__/docs/screenshots/1330/04-en-after-switch.png)

## Validation
`apps/desktop` tests: **1631 tests, 141 suites, 0 failed**. `tsc --noEmit` for `apps/desktop` and for the root `tsconfig.tests.json`: exit 0. `scripts/check-architecture.mjs`: OK, **392** package source files. 10 files changed; nothing under `.github`, `.ci`, `application`, `services`, `packages` or `test`.

## E2E user journeys
BLOCKED: the mocked desktop entry cannot hold a run in the running state; the mid-run flyout is covered by component tests (note present while running in both languages and absent when idle; the pill is enabled and its title says the change affects later calls).

## Release
Release: release:fix. Impact: the permission mode can be changed during a run, and opening its flyout then explains the scope of the change. Compatibility: none.

Closes #1330

由 agent 自报，平台未重跑。

items.body: ## What Chinese screens name this feature 研究思路树; English screens keep "Idea Tree". No identifier, command, key or API path changes. ## Why The Chinese interface showed the product term in English, and in two places the raw identifier `idea-tree`: the 会话设置 row that opens the parameters card, and that card's own title. The web research card header and the canvas `aria-label` were hardcoded strings that never reached the message table, so a zh-CN reader saw the English name there too. ## Scope Locale tables (values only): - `apps/desktop/src/text/zh.ts` — 10 values: the session-menu row, the parameters card title and hint, the settings group label, the three "service not ready" lines, the panel heading, its empty state and the create dialog title. - `apps/web/src/i18n/messages.ts` — 18 values in the `zhCN` table, plus two new keys that both tables carry: `ideaResearch.cardTitle` and `ideaTree.canvas.ariaLabel` (`Idea Tree {id}` / `研究思路树 {id}`). Code that rendered a fixed English name: - `apps/web/src/IdeaResearchCard.tsx` header now reads `ideaResearch.cardTitle`. - `apps/web/src/IdeaTreeCanvas.tsx` `aria-label` now reads `ideaTree.canvas.ariaLabel`. A fixed Chinese name on the service side: - `services/api/src/http/index.ts` — the assistant turn appended when a research is created now reads `已启动研究思路树（…）。…请在研究思路树卡片查看实时进度…`. That sentence is what a zh-CN reader sees in the transcript, and it was the last place the English name survived after the tables were renamed. - `test/helpers/idea-research-model.ts` — the mocked model reply that echoes that sentence carries the same name. Two e2e journeys drive the app in zh-CN and pinned the old wording, so the rename broke them: `test/journey-idea-tree-fixture.spec.ts` looked up the control region by the exact name `Idea Tree 研究控制`, the settings group button by `/^Idea Tree/` and the explorer dialog by `/Idea Tree (explorer|浏览器)/`; `test/journey-idea-tree-real.spec.ts` pinned the control region name twice. Both now match either locale's name, the way those files already do for other controls, so they hold in `en` and `zh-CN`. This is why `L2 E2E (mocked, standard-config)` failed on `5bf0238d`: step 1 never found the settings group button. One locator could not simply be renamed at first: `研究思路树已启动` is the timeline card's loading placeholder (`IdeaResearchTimelineCard.tsx:26`), rendered only until its first view lands, and the transcript line that used to satisfy the assertion came from the API's fixed Chinese sentence. With that sentence renamed here, the step asserts the appended turn (`/已启动研究思路树/`) — a lasting signal that also pins the service copy — instead of the transient placeholder. Tests pin the copy instead of the old words: the dialog heading by its `#idea-tree-override-title` node, the web card header in both locales, the canvas label in the existing zh-CN render, and the three assertions that used to name `idea-tree` / `Idea Tree`. Not changed: the English tables (`text/en.ts` and `en`), the `/idea-tree-team` command and `/idea-tree` handling, the `idea-tree` settings group id, every other identifier and API path. - **Docs are out of scope by decision** (the request was the Chinese interface): `docs/` still says "Idea Tree", and its terminology follows in a separate change. Stated here so the gap is a decision rather than an omission. - The settings group description keeps saying 假设树: it names the artifact the settings configure, while the label names the feature. - `services/api/src/store.test.ts` uses that sentence as sample text in a session-naming test. It is fixture text rather than product copy, so it stays as it is. Where the Chinese word 研究 already followed the name ("Idea Tree 研究"), the duplicate is dropped: 「正在建立研究思路树」, 「研究思路树已启动」. ## Rebase Main moved 23 commits while this was in review (`78ad0029` → `c9f02f2f`), so the branch went `dirty`. It is rebased, not merged: the four commits are replayed on `c9f02f2f` and kept as four commits; the diff is still the same 12 files, `+83/−40`. Three of the four files that main also touched merged cleanly with both sides kept (`apps/desktop/src/text/zh.ts`, `apps/web/src/IdeaResearchCard.tsx`, `apps/desktop/tests/settings-pages.test.tsx`). `apps/web/tests/IdeaResearchCard.test.tsx` conflicted because main appended its own test at the same end of file: resolved by keeping both tests — main's `a delayed research list cannot replace a newer paused stream update` and this PR's `the research card header follows the reader's language`. This force-push dismissed the approve that `a4efd86c` carried, which is the cost of the rebase rather than a code change. ## Verification On `5bf0238d`, in a worktree built from the base tarball with the workspace packages built (the head after it, `d4223f56`, changes only the two e2e specs and nothing those suites load): - desktop: `tsx --import ./tests/support/css-preload.mjs --test tests/*.test.ts tests/*.test.tsx` → **1591 tests, 1591 pass, 0 fail**. - web: `tsx --test tests/*.test.ts tests/*.test.tsx` → **1422 tests, 1422 pass, 0 fail**. - `tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.json --noEmit` and `tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit` → exit 0. - CI on `a4efd86c`: every job that ran is green, including both `L2 E2E (mocked,` `standard-config)` and `standard-journeys)`, which is the fix below confirmed. - After the rebase the merged files were run over the base tree (that checkout has no main beyond `78ad0029`): web **1423 pass / 0 fail**; desktop **1588 pass / 4 fail**, and all four failures are main's new skills/skeleton tests in `settings-pages.test.tsx`, which cannot pass there because the code they exercise is part of main's other commits, not of this PR. The rebased tree itself is what CI runs; this note is what I could run locally. - CI on `5bf0238d`: `L2 E2E (mocked, standard-config)` failed (`journey-idea-tree-fixture.spec.ts`, step 1, test timeout). The cause is the pinned zh-CN wording described under Scope, not product code: the journey hunted a settings group button named `Idea Tree …` that no longer exists. Fixed on `d4223f56`; the unit suites are untouched by that commit (two spec files only). - Mutation, both directions: with the two locale tables reverted to the base and the tests kept, the suites go red where they pin the words (desktop `会话设置 carries the idea-tree entry…` and `the settings tree`; web `keeps an autonomous Idea Tree research card…`). With the parameters-card title and the two web components reverted, the three new assertions go red on their own. ## Screenshots zh-CN desktop (mocked desktop harness: `fixtures.ts` intercepts `/api/**`, no real backend or session, viewport 1280×820) and zh-CN / en web (`vite dev` for `apps/web` plus Playwright route mocking of `/api/**`). Images are pinned to commit `742201753dd351992b8998c7655668bd84c34b79` of branch `yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery:screenshots-1459`, so the links do not depend on this PR's branch. **1. Settings: the group and the page it opens** | group list | page | |---|---| | ![settings group list with 研究思路树](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery/742201753dd351992b8998c7655668bd84c34b79/shots/1459/desktop-settings-nav.png) | ![settings page headed 研究思路树](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery/742201753dd351992b8998c7655668bd84c34b79/shots/1459/desktop-settings-page.png) | **2. 会话设置 row and the parameters card it opens** | session menu | parameters card | |---|---| | ![session menu row 研究思路树](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery/742201753dd351992b8998c7655668bd84c34b79/shots/1459/desktop-session-menu.png) | ![parameters card titled 研究思路树参数](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery/742201753dd351992b8998c7655668bd84c34b79/shots/1459/desktop-params-card.png) | **3. The in-session research panel** | panel | in the window | |---|---| | ![research panel headed 研究思路树](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery/742201753dd351992b8998c7655668bd84c34b79/shots/1459/desktop-research-panel.png) | ![panel inside the task tab](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery/742201753dd351992b8998c7655668bd84c34b79/shots/1459/desktop-research-panel-full.png) | **4. Web settings, zh-CN and en** | group list (zh-CN) | page (zh-CN) | group list (en) | |---|---|---| | ![web settings group list 研究思路树](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery/742201753dd351992b8998c7655668bd84c34b79/shots/1459/web-settings-nav.png) | ![web settings page 研究思路树](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery/742201753dd351992b8998c7655668bd84c34b79/shots/1459/web-settings-page.png) | ![web settings group list Idea Tree](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery/742201753dd351992b8998c7655668bd84c34b79/shots/1459/web-settings-nav-en.png) | **5. The web research card header, which used to be a hardcoded `Idea Tree`** | zh-CN | en | |---|---| | ![web card header 研究思路树](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery/742201753dd351992b8998c7655668bd84c34b79/shots/1459/web-card-zh-CN.png) | ![web card header Idea Tree](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery/742201753dd351992b8998c7655668bd84c34b79/shots/1459/web-card-en.png) | **6. The tree canvas, whose `aria-label` also used to be hardcoded** | zh-CN | en | |---|---| | ![canvas labelled 研究思路树 tree-1](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery/742201753dd351992b8998c7655668bd84c34b79/shots/1459/web-canvas-zh-CN.png) | ![canvas labelled Idea Tree tree-1](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yuanzhou75/sciencediscovery/742201753dd351992b8998c7655668bd84c34b79/shots/1459/web-canvas-en.png) | DOM sampled in the same runs: the desktop settings row and page title read `研究思路树`; that row's description still reads `假设树的研究范围与阶段提示词` (deliberate — see Scope); the session-menu row reads `研究思路树` and the card title `研究思路树参数`; the panel's heading reads `研究思路树` over `进行中 构建假设树 第 1 轮`; the web card header reads `研究思路树`; and the canvas carries `aria-label="研究思路树 tree-1"` in zh-CN against `Idea Tree tree-1` in en. Two limits of the frames, stated rather than papered over: - The panel's body says `这棵研究树还没有节点。` — that is the tree area's empty state (`TEXT.ideaTree.detail.empty`). `TEXT.ideaTree.empty` (`这个会话还没有研究思路树。`, renamed here for consistency) has no consumer in `apps/desktop/src` at this head: the panel only opens for an existing research, so there is no "no research yet" surface to show. Renaming an unreachable value is not the place to invent one. - The two web card frames are component-level mounts — the real `IdeaResearchCard` with the real stylesheet and the real `LocaleProvider`, with a stubbed client feeding one research — not a full web session page. A full page needs the whole session state to mount `IdeaTreeView`, and the frame that matters here is the card header this PR moved onto `ideaResearch.cardTitle`.

Closes #1251

Search Sessions, projects and artifacts from the desktop client — #1251's search, opened from the column's title row.

**No longer stacked.** `#1250` is merged, so the diff is this PR's own delta only.

## The owner's decision, quoted

On 2026-11-26 the code owner asked for this shape, in these words:

> 「我需要你把搜索的放大镜图标放到左上角的科研会话那个高度，然后放在侧边栏的右侧，在"收起侧栏"图标左边一点的位置，注意控制间距，不要离得太远了。点击放大镜之后，在屏幕中央出现弹窗，弹窗上支持输入搜索内容，弹窗最底部支持筛选类型：全部，项目，会话，产物（我不确定还有没有别的，如果有，你就自己加）。如果用户选择的是全部，搜索结果要按照类型做分类，按照时间由新到旧排序。」

The owner also withdrew #1251's fourth criterion — the narrowing (仅当前项目 / 仅运行中 /
有产物 / 时间窗口, the choice surviving a reload) — on 2026-11-26 at 22:18 CST. That is why this
delivery is smaller than the criterion list, and the record is in the repository rather than in
this description alone: criterion 4 is struck through in [#1251](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/issues/1251)
under *Withdrawn scope*, and the decision — what, who, when — is written out in
[this comment](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/sciencediscovery/issues/1251#issuecomment-7194112097) on the issue.

## What the column does

**搜索 is a magnifier in the title row, not a row in the list.** It sits beside 收起侧栏,
8px from it, and opens a dialog in the middle of the window: the field, the hits and the
kinds, with the page behind it dimmed. Ctrl/Cmd+K opens the same dialog, Escape closes it.

**The field holds the caret when the dialog opens**, so the keys work without a click:
`Escape` closes, `↑`/`↓` walk the hits in the order drawn, `Enter` opens the one under the
cursor. Opening a hit closes the dialog and hands the hit to the workspace, which opens the
Session, Project or artifact it names.

**The dialog's footer is its only filter:** 全部, 项目, 会话, 产物. 全部 groups the hits
by kind in that order, and every group is newest first; a kind shows only itself. Ordering
is read from the rows themselves — `WorkbenchSearchResult` now carries `updatedAt` (a
Session's own stamp, an artifact's, or for a Project the stamp of its newest Session) —
because the route promises no order of its own.

**Search covers active Sessions.** An archived Session is not searchable and neither are
its artifacts; an imported read-only snapshot **is** searchable — 活跃 is archived versus
live, not writable versus read-only (the owner's answer, recorded here so the choice can
be checked).

**The narrowings are gone.** 项目范围 / 运行中 / 有产物 / 指定时间 used to hang off the
search row; with the row removed there is nowhere for them to live, and the owner's
decision was to drop the feature rather than move it. The column lists every active
Session again, and the stored preference, its module and its tests are gone with it. The
copy those controls used — twenty `sidebar.*` keys, both dictionaries — is gone too, so a
reader cannot find the labels of a control that no longer exists.

## What this does **not** claim

- The field searches names and titles, not message bodies; the route says so, and the empty state repeats it rather than implying a full-text search.
- The dialog is mounted by the column, as the search row was: with the column collapsed or the workbench panel open, neither the magnifier nor Ctrl/Cmd+K reaches search. That is the reach the row had, not a new limit — but it is a limit.
- A kind cannot count the kinds it is not showing. Under 全部 the note counts what the answer held back; under a kind it says that more exist, without a number.

## Verification

Run in WSL (Ubuntu, linux-amd64, Node v22.23.4) against this head's tree:

- `tsc -p apps/desktop --noEmit` — clean; `tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --noEmit` — clean.
- Desktop suite — **1612 tests / 1612 pass**, including the dialog's own cases (`tests/search-dialog.test.tsx`: the kinds keep 项目 → 会话 → 产物 and sort newest first inside each group, a kind shows only itself, the footer is the only filter, an empty answer / a failure / an unfinished list each say their own thing, a kind's note counts no other kind, and an untouched field asks for a query). `tests/sidebar.test.tsx` holds the title-row magnifier and asserts the column draws no search row and no field.
- `apps/desktop/e2e/search-dialog.spec.ts` — **3 cases, pass** in the mocked desktop gate (`node .ci/run-desktop-e2e.mjs mocked`, local run): the magnifier opens the dialog and the caret is in the field, 全部 draws 项目 → 会话 → 产物 with the newest first, Ctrl/Cmd+K reaches the same dialog, `↓ ↓` then `Enter` reads the Session the hit names, Escape closes, and a kind's note drops the number. Nothing in that file drives React state; it is the page, which is why it caught the field's missing `ref`.
- `services/api/src/workbench/index.test.ts` — 4 cases pass, including the one this
  branch's additive `updatedAt` invalidated (it asserted a Project hit by deep equality) and
  a new case for the stamp rule: a Session and an artifact know their own, a Project takes
  its newest Session's, and a Project with no Sessions falls back to its birth.
- `node --test .ci/*.test.mjs` — 231 tests, all pass, so the policy still selects this change's desktop spec.
- `test/source-test-map.json` — the dialog's entry now names both its unit file and the new spec; the deleted capture harness and the deleted filter modules are gone from the map.

The required checks on the previous head were green (`merge-gate`, `UT`, `ST`, `L1`, `L2`,
`Docker image`, `Freeze mocked E2E matrix`, `Desktop UI-ST and mocked E2E`, `Coverage`, both
`Binary release` legs); this head's checks are still running at the time of writing — the
Checks tab is the place to read them. `CodeCheck (GitCode)` is the mirror's own label and
not a required check: 未定位、非必需，需有权限者查看.

## Screenshots

**UI:** the **code owner has looked at these captures and accepted this version** (2026-11-26).
A later change to these frames would need the same look again — a code-only approval is not
enough for UI.

Rendered from `688a155c`, the head this PR asks to approve, in one capture run against that
tree, in the bundle the desktop gate builds, driven by the suite's own harness
(`installMockApi` from `apps/desktop/e2e/fixtures.ts`, plus a stubbed `GET /api/search`) at
viewport 1440×940 with `deviceScaleFactor: 2`, one browser context per locale with
`sciencediscovery-desktop:locale` set before the first paint. Ten frames: the column's title
row, and the dialog as it opens, grouped under 全部, and filtered to each kind.

The frames describe this head: the only change since `688a155c` is
`services/api/src/workbench/index.test.ts`.

All ten images live in **one** storage commit,
`b308cea3a01dbb71e347bcbef2197f60c946ce48`; the previous set's directory was removed in the
same commit, so the branch holds one set.

| | 中文 | English |

items.body:
## What changes

The first-run wizard's data-directory page probes the input on a 400ms debounce, and its writability check was `ensureWritableDir` — `mkdirSync(recursive)` plus a write probe. Every half-typed value therefore created real directories on the user's disk: typing `D:\ai\sd\data` left `D:\ai` and `D:\ai\sd` behind whenever the path was retyped or abandoned, and page-load auto-probing pre-created the default `%LocalAppDATA%\ScienceDiscovery` before any user choice. This is the same litter class as problems W8 (half-typed relative paths resolving under the CWD) — W8's guards covered the CWD and the install root, but not intermediate values of legitimate absolute paths.

- `application/src/wizard-data-dir.ts`: add `nearestExistingDir` (walks up like `freeBytesForPath`) and `probeWritableWithoutMkdir` — the write probe now lands in the nearest EXISTING ancestor and is deleted immediately, so input-time probing never creates anything. `ensureWritableDir` is unchanged and becomes the confirm-time primitive.
- `application/src/main.ts`: `wizard-confirm-dir` runs `ensureWritableDir` after the read-only checks pass and before saving wizard state — the chosen dir first exists when the user confirms (matching the page copy), and a file squatting on the target fails here with a truthful message instead of after the state was saved.
- `application/test/wizard-data-dir.test.ts`: 5 new cases.

## Impact to review

Behaviour change is confined to the wizard's data-directory page:

- Input-time probing (typing, browse-pick, page-load default) no longer creates directories — it was the bug.
- Directory creation moves to confirm time. The page copy "确认后将在选定的目录准备运行环境" now matches the actual timing.
- One accepted weakening: "a file occupies the target path" is no longer discovered during typing; it reads as generic 不可写 on the check page (the ancestor probe writes into the file and fails) and fails at confirm time with "目录创建失败（请检查权限或杀毒软件）" — before any wizard state is saved.
- W8 (relative-path CWD guard) and W16 (install-root collision ordering) behaviour and tests are unchanged and green.

## Validation

- `application` unit tests: `wizard-data-dir.test.ts` 28/28 including the new cases — probing a half-typed path leaves no directories behind (`existsSync` asserted false for every intermediate value); probing an existing dir is idempotent; a file on the target reads as unwritable; `nearestExistingDir` anchor semantics; `probeWritableWithoutMkdir` rejects relative/drive-relative input without touching the filesystem.
- Wizard core files (`wizard-data-dir` / `wizard-state` / `wizard-dom` / `uninstall-data`): 57 pass / 0 fail / 1 pre-existing skip.
- `tsc -p application/tsconfig.json --noEmit`: clean.
- Full `application` suite: 362/367; the single failure (`updater.test.ts`, missing `electron-updater` package in the local environment) reproduces on the untouched main baseline — environment-level, unrelated to this change.

## E2E user journeys

Manual journey covered by the new unit cases; a packaged-install journey re-run is planned with the next build (the wizard flow itself is unchanged step-for-step, only the side-effect timing moved). UT-level: typing `<tmp>\ai\sd\data` with 400ms pauses asserts zero residue on disk; retyping to a different path asserts no leftovers from the abandoned attempt.

## Release

Release category: release:patch
User impact: No data migration; existing installs keep their wizard state. New and re-onboarded users no longer get junk directories from half-typed paths, and the chosen data directory is created only on explicit confirmation.
Compatibility: `ensureWritableDir` remains exported and its self-defence (never mkdir a relative path) is intact; callers outside the wizard flow are unaffected.

items.author: agent-ci-infra-bot[bot]
items.body:
Desktop Skill imports installed packages without saying whether the package was switched on, and a Git import could install a repository the form no longer showed. Main has since redesigned this surface into dialogs and notices, so the fixes are expressed in that design rather than rebased on top of the old one.

## F1 — a stale page could import another repository
`SkillGitImportView` owns its results by generation: every field edit, reset and new inspection invalidates and aborts a pending page. A page whose repository/commit differs from the rows on screen is discarded, and import refuses a source the displayed rows were not read from, asking for a fresh inspection.

## F2 — upload hid the activation failure
The upload dialog keeps the package's activation outcome. When the switch is refused the dialog stays open with the reason and a 启用 retry that repeats only the enable request, so recovery never uploads the package again; a successful retry closes it on the usual success notice.

## F3 — git auto-enable failures were swallowed
`enableCreatedSkills` reports per-package failures and, separately, a failed skill-state read, and a failed run is no longer cached, so a retry really re-issues the read and the switches. The notice belongs to the job that produced it: it has its own identity and close, survives dismissing the import/progress notice, and a later import that switches its own packages on cleanly leaves it in place. Its retry only re-enables.

## F5 — activation skipped, reported as a failed save
When the catalog page has not loaded, the switch state is read directly and the package is enabled instead of inferring "no switches" and reporting a failed save for a write that never happened.

## Validation
- `pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/desktop exec tsx --import ./tests/support/css-preload.mjs --test tests/skills-settings.test.tsx tests/skills-import-edit.test.tsx tests/git-skill-import-job.test.ts` → 60 passed, 0 failed.
- `pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/desktop test` → 1650 passed, 0 failed; `pnpm typecheck` and the desktop build pass.
- The regression cases fail on the pre-fix sources (8 of 45), and the new job-identity case fails against the previous unconditional activation notice.

## Not covered
Finding 3 / F4 (the in-memory job/activation lifecycle) is deliberately untouched: it still needs the product decision requested on the Issue, and no client-refresh journey is claimed or required.

## Release
Release category: release:fix
User impact: a refused activation is reported, outlives the import notice and any later successful import, and is retryable without reimporting; a Git import can no longer install a repository the fields no longer name.
Compatibility and migration: none.

Closes #1442

### 测试

```
pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/desktop exec tsx --import ./tests/support/css-preload.mjs --test tests/skills-settings.test.tsx tests/skills-import-edit.test.tsx tests/git-skill-import-job.test.ts
```

## What changed
- `search_finished` names the populations apart: `attempts` (every selection that spent a round, failed calls included), `generated` (distinct new programs, seed excluded), `evaluated` (scored candidates) and `archiveNodes` (baseline included). `candidates` keeps its baseline-inclusive meaning; older events omit the new fields.
- The engine's shortfall log and `summariseRun` measure the plan against attempts, so a 6-round run with one failed call no longer reads as "made 5 of 6".
- `expanded.depth` comes from the `parent_id` chain (root 0, unknown parent 0) in all three emitters; failed/empty attempts use their selected parent's depth. `iteration`/`nodeIndex` are unchanged.
- OpenEvolve publishes only `gateScore`; it no longer copies it into `rolloutScore`. Old persisted events are not migrated; readers fall back, as the schema documents.
- The API fold reconciles a stored run's `candidates` with `attempts` at the terminal event, and the web view judges the shortfall on `attempts`.

items.body:
## What

Three fixes on the desktop Review Specialist card.

**A Deep review no longer asks for a Deep review.** When the Deep pass ended without a verdict, the card kept the Quick pass's claim-support row, so it told the reader to run the level they had just run. The gap row now reports what the Deep attempt itself produced. The stage-level "语义" row is gone: `smartStatus` is one verdict for the whole stage, so it repeated the gap above it and contradicted the per-claim source rows below it.

**Warnings are amber again.** Rows for `warning` findings were painted red while their own text called them a reminder. Red now means a critical finding, a contradiction, or an incomplete delivery; warnings are counted separately in the header, as the web client already splits them.

**The card renders at the end of the turn it reviewed.** A checkpoint message is persisted when the review starts — mid-turn, before the run writes its answer — so the stored order drew the card under the question and above the work it is a verdict on. Cards are now drawn after their turn's answer. A card written by the running turn is held until that turn ends; a card from an earlier turn, or a review the reader started from the session menu, is drawn at once.

The visible wording follows: the check tooltip now names Deep review rather than "the source service", and the unreachable "source verification reached no conclusion" string (and its body) is removed with the stage row it described.

## Validation

- `apps/desktop` unit suite: 1600 pass / 0 fail
- Desktop e2e (`reviewer.spec.ts` + `conversation.spec.ts`, Chromium, `/api/**` mocked): 16 passed / 0 failed / 0 skipped
- `pnpm typecheck` across the workspace: clean

## E2E user journeys

PASS for the card's content, tone and placement as far as the mocked suite reaches: the 14 `reviewer.spec.ts` journeys cover the Quick/Deep outcome matrix, the Deep gap and tone, and the card arriving on its own after the coordinator finishes; `conversation.spec.ts` covers compose/answer/replay.

The new end-of-turn placement is asserted by unit tests (`apps/desktop/tests/conversation.test.tsx`, 7 cases including the boundaries: card after its turn's answer, card above the next turn, a checkpoint written before the first question, two checkpoints in one turn, live-turn card held until the turn ends with the manual review exempt, a card whose write time is unreadable drawn rather than hidden, earlier-turn card drawn while the next turn streams) — the mocked fixtures do not model a checkpoint persisted mid-run, so no browser journey covers that ordering yet.

## Release

Release category: `release:fix` (the GitHub label is pending a maintainer — this fork has no write access to upstream labels)
User impact: a Deep review card now says what the Deep pass actually produced instead of asking for a Deep review; warnings are amber rather than red; the card appears under the turn's answer instead of under the question.
Compatibility and migration: none.

A criterion may be called `score` (the control plane's default), yet domains merged raw measurements and the normalised aggregate under that key: raw 0.6 became 0.3, the baseline reference stayed empty so `relative_to_baseline` normalised each candidate against itself, and reporters filtered `score` out (`criteria: {}`).

## Changes
- New `outcome.py` owns the reserved names and shape: `score` (aggregate), `criteria` (normalised per criterion, the event payload), `rawCriteria` (measurements). `metrics[<id>]` stays raw for non-colliding ids.
- `script_domain`, `scorecard_domain`, `test_gate_domain` and `judge_domain` build through it; `score`/`seconds` keep their raw value.
- Both engines seed baselines from `rawCriteria` and publish the normalised map in `evaluated.criteria`; probes read the same.
- Scope: `dataset_metric` and `test_gate` had the same collision and use the helper. The probe's `custom_script` branch is wired: it fills a baseline reference before scoring the damaged copy, so acceptance bullet 3 is met there, not narrowed to `dataset_metric`. `_probe_gated` wiring is included too (latent today; proposals force identity for `test_gate`).
- `score` is not rejected; existing evaluators and stored runs keep working.

## Verification
`test_outcome.py` (15): `score` clamp [0,2] on raw 0.6 keeps raw 0.6 and aggregate 0.3 in all three domains; a differently named criterion; `seconds`; both probes; both reporters; plus engine-level PUCT/OpenEvolve tests (root raw 0.6, candidate raw 1.2 -> reward/criteria 0.3333), which fail if either seeding line reverts. Pre-fix: 14 failed / 1 passed; fixed: 15 passed.

`pnpm evolve:test`: 428 passed, 27 failed — all `SandboxUnavailable` (no bwrap here) and the same 27 fail on unmodified main. `pnpm ci:ut`/`ci:st` planned 8565/69, executed 0 (jiuwenswarm backend unavailable).

## Risk
`evaluated.criteria` now carries the documented normalised values; raw values live in `metrics.rawCriteria`.

Release category: release:fix

Closes #1458

Apply the updated MCP design to the desktop settings page. Scope is MCP only; Skills and Specialists retain current main behavior and UI.

- Add All / My / Official catalog tabs, name/description search, responsive cards, and filtered bulk enable/disable with partial-failure retry.
- Use centered create, edit and details dialogs. The single dark Add dropdown offers manual entry or JSON file/paste prefilling in the same editable confirmation form.
- Keep card, details and form service switches synchronized. Session defaults remain independent in details; built-in sources keep their supported default-selection control.
- Add Try it to open a fresh conversation with the chosen MCP and current model, without sending a message or granting extra permissions.
- Preserve HTTP/SSE/STDIO, exact legacy arguments, stored credentials, OAuth start/cancel/open/clear, actual tool previews, latest-check feedback and named deletion confirmation.

### Regression test design

- Search and switch catalog categories; apply a filtered bulk operation, refuse one write, and retry without rewriting successful or hidden services.
- Persist both service-enable directions, reopen the editor and reload; keep session defaults independent and recover refused writes or cancelled edits.
- Retain HTTP OAuth configuration and the stored client-secret sentinel, as well as exact STDIO argument arrays and stored environment/header credentials.
- Fill manual or JSON file/paste configurations, edit before confirming, validate hidden batch entries, and retry partial imports without duplicates.
- Keep the JSON caret in the source through repeated valid parses; hand focus to filled fields only after file upload.
- Show refused authorization/clear-grant operations inside the visible details dialog and allow retry.
- Verify first/last keyboard entry and wraparound, Escape/focus return, modal focus containment and busy locks.
- Recover a blocked OAuth popup, cancel or clear authorization, and retain the open-page action's plain styling and new-tab/opener-isolation attributes.
- Open a source-specific trial conversation without sending. The separate SDK Echo journey then explicitly sends a prompt, verifies the invocation/result, persists edits, cancels/confirms deletion and checks reference cleanup.
- Inspect English/Chinese layouts and smaller windows while retaining Skills and Specialists behavior.

Captured from design implementation `9a973e427` before it was ported onto current main for this PR; these show the new layout and are not captures or CI results of the rebased head. items.body:
`state_for()` settled restart orphans on every read: `list`, `get` and `events` (once per streamed frame) all call it, so reading even an archived, read-only Session rewrote the research to `interrupted`, stamped the restart reason and closed its running activities.

## Changes
- `state_for()` is now a pure read of the in-process engine state or the stored file; it never calls `store().save()`.
- New `reconcile_orphaned_researches()` runs the verdict once: `running`/`pausing` researches become `interrupted` with the existing reason, running activities become `stopped` with `finishedAt`/`error`, saved, logged and counted. It skips ids a live engine owns and leaves paused/completed records byte-identical.
- `server.py` calls it from a FastAPI `lifespan` startup hook, so the verdict lands at the restart instead of on the first read; a failure is logged without blocking boot.
- Read-only API semantics unchanged (`list`/`get`/`defaults` may read a read-only Session; mutations still use `assertSessionWritable`); no multi-worker assumption added.

## Validation
`pytest services/evolve/tests/test_idea_research.py services/evolve/tests/test_server.py -q` → 69 passed, 0 failed. New tests: list/get/events leave the file byte-identical with status `running` (failing against the old write); reconciliation settles only `running`/`pausing` (second pass 0, live engine skipped, log asserted); the server test boots via `TestClient(module.app)`, so removing the `lifespan=` wiring makes it fail.

Full evolve UT `pnpm evolve:test` → 416 passed, 27 failed; the same 27 fail on unmodified main (413 passed, 27 failed): this host has no bubblewrap and all 27 are sandbox tests untouched here. CI provisions it.

## E2E user journeys
BLOCKED locally: the stack needs the bubblewrap sandbox this host lacks; the mocked browser layer runs in CI.

## Release
Release category: release:fix
User impact: reads no longer change a research; a restart still settles orphans, at boot.
Compatibility: none.

Closes #1456

### Tests

```
uv run --project services/evolve --extra test --extra candidates pytest services/evolve/tests/test_idea_research.py services/evolve/tests/test_server.py -q
```

items.author: zhaozhaozz
items.body:
## Summary

1. Routes only **merge queue (`merge_group`)** runs of **`UT`** and the three heavy **L2 mocked E2E shards (`standard-config`, `standard-journeys`, `research`)** to self-hosted Docker runners (`[self-hosted, Linux, X64, sciencediscovery]`), gated behind the repository variable `CI_SELF_HOSTED_MERGE_QUEUE == 'true'` (default off).
2. Enables **in-runner 2-stack local parallelism (`CI_E2E_LOCAL_CONCURRENCY=2`)** for the two long standard mocked E2E shards (`standard-config` and `standard-journeys`) so each job runs two fully isolated local stacks in parallel (disjoint loopback ports, runtime directories, `JIUWENSWARM_HOME` roots, desktop Vite port/cache directories, and Playwright `workers: 1`), cutting L2 end-to-end wall time roughly in half on both self-hosted and GitHub-hosted runners.

Closes #1360

## Motivation

In merge-queue runs, `UT` (~13 min) and the three heavy L2 mocked E2E shards (`standard-config` ~20 min, `standard-journeys` ~20 min plus ~3.5 min queued behind `max-parallel: 4`, `research` ~10 min) dominate wall-clock time before `L3 real E2E` can start. Moving those four trusted merge-queue jobs onto dedicated Dockerized self-hosted runners with container-local caches and running 2 isolated stacks inside each of the two long standard shards brings all four jobs into a ~9–12 min band without exposing self-hosted runners to untrusted `pull_request` (or fork) runs or splitting any spec file.

## Changes

### Merge-queue self-hosted routing & container-local cache
- **`.ci/tier-policy.mjs`**:
  - Export `SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER = ['self-hosted', 'Linux', 'X64', 'sciencediscovery']`.
  - Compute `self_hosted_merge_queue = event === 'merge_group' && selfHostedMergeQueue === true` and `ut_runner` (`SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER` when enabled, otherwise `'ubuntu-latest'`). Non-`merge_group` events (`pull_request`, `workflow_dispatch`, `workflow_call`, `schedule`, `push`) always fail closed to `'ubuntu-latest'`.
- **`.ci/mocked-matrix.mjs`**:
  - Export `HEAVY_MOCKED_SHARDS` (`standard-config`, `standard-journeys`, `research`) and `buildMockedMatrix()`.
  - Emit `runner`, `self_hosted`, and `local_concurrency` (`2` for `standard-config`/`standard-journeys`, `1` for `research`/`governed`/`literature`) per shard.
- **`.ci/use-local-swarm-cache.sh`**:
  - Manage a `flock`-serialized, content-hashed read-only JiuwenSwarm installation under `${SD_CI_CACHE_DIR:-/ci-cache}/jiuwenswarm/<key>/src`.
  - Strip `.git` and pre-install `pytest>=8.3.5` (for `check:swarm-contract`) while holding the lock so concurrent UT/E2E jobs never mutate the shared venv and `scripts/jiuwenswarm.sh setup` takes its pre-installed read-only fast path while every job keeps its own isolated `JIUWENSWARM_HOME` under `CI_RUNTIME_DIR`.
  - Export only `JIUWENSWARM_SRC` to `$GITHUB_ENV`.
- **`.github/workflows/ci.yml`**:
  - Wire `vars.CI_SELF_HOSTED_MERGE_QUEUE` through `policy` -> `e2e-plan` / `ut` / `e2e`.
  - Raise mocked `e2e` `max-parallel` from `4` to `5` and pass `CI_E2E_LOCAL_CONCURRENCY: ${{ matrix.local_concurrency }}`.
  - Skip cross-region `actions/cache` round trips (pnpm, uv, Playwright Chromium, JiuwenSwarm) only when a job is routed to a self-hosted runner, replacing JiuwenSwarm cache restore with `.ci/use-local-swarm-cache.sh`.
  - Make `Provision the bubblewrap sandbox` idempotent in `ut` and `e2e` by probing `bwrap --unshare-user --ro-bind / / --dev /dev true` before invoking `sudo apt-get` / `sudo sysctl`.
- **`test/support/tagged/shared.mjs`**:
  - Export `sharedCacheEnv()` and honor pre-set `UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR`, `npm_config_cache`, and `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH` (matching existing `UV_CACHE_DIR` handling) while preserving exact workspace-local fallbacks when unset.

### In-runner 2-stack local parallelism (`standard-config` & `standard-journeys`)
- **`test/support/tagged/execution.mjs`**:
  - Export `PARALLEL_MOCKED_SHARDS`, `mockedLocalConcurrency()`, `splitEntriesByFile()`, `mockedExecutionLanes()`, and `mockedSlotEnvironment()`.
  - Balance whole spec files across 2 lanes (never splitting a spec file across stacks); for `standard-config`, keep `mocked-standard-config-fresh` in its own pristine stack and keep the 9 JiuwenSwarm supplemental checks exclusively on `mocked-standard-config-global`. Single-file PR selections and non-standard shards (`research`, `governed`, `literature`) remain single-stack.
- **`test/support/tagged/shared.mjs`**:
  - Execute `mockedExecutionLanes()` concurrently via `Promise.all` with disjoint loopback port blocks (`4410`/`4420`, `4411`/`4421`, `4510`/`4520`, `17774`/`17784`, desktop Vite `4178`/`4179`), separate `CI_RUNTIME_DIR`, `JIUWENSWARM_HOME`, and Vite cache dirs. Default remains `1` (serial) for local `pnpm ci:e2e`.
- **`.ci/run-e2e.sh`**:
  - Serialize JiuwenSwarm port allocation across concurrent local stacks via `CI_E2E_SWARM_START_LOCK` (`flock`), explicitly closing fd 8 (`8>&-`) on child commands so daemonized processes never inherit the lock descriptor; avoid redundant `ln -sfn` rewrites on `test/node_modules`.
- **`test/helpers/desktop-evolve.ts` & `apps/desktop/vite.config.ts`**:
  - Honor `E2E_DESKTOP_PORT` (default `4178`) and `E2E_DESKTOP_VITE_CACHE_DIR` so concurrent desktop-entry specs never collide on Vite port or `.vite` cache.
- **`.ci/mocked-report.mjs`**:
  - Audit all `mocked-*` sub-lane directories in shard artifacts so any unexpected `jiuwenswarm-checks.json` outside the single designated check batch fails with `UNEXPECTED_SWARM_CHECKS`.
- **`.ci/README.md`, `.ci/mocked-shards.test.mjs`, `.ci/self-hosted-merge-queue.test.mjs`**:
  - Document the toggle, `max-parallel: 5`, and `CI_E2E_LOCAL_CONCURRENCY=2`, and add unit, CLI, workflow contract, reconciliation, and hermetic shell tests.

## Safety & Rollout

- **Default off for self-hosted routing**: While `vars.CI_SELF_HOSTED_MERGE_QUEUE` is unset, all PR and merge-queue jobs stay on `ubuntu-latest`. Clearing or changing the variable rolls back immediately with no workflow edit.
- **Event boundary**: `pull_request` (including forks), `workflow_dispatch`, `schedule`, `push`, light mocked shards (`governed`, `literature`), `ST`, desktop jobs, packaging, and real E2E jobs never route to self-hosted runners even when `CI_SELF_HOSTED_MERGE_QUEUE=true`.
- **Strong isolation**: Each local E2E lane runs its own isolated service stack and Playwright `workers: 1`; `CI_E2E_LOCAL_CONCURRENCY=1` reverts any run to serial execution.

## Verification

### Local static & unit checks
- `node --test .ci/self-hosted-merge-queue.test.mjs`: **8/8 passed** (0 failed, 0 skipped)
- `node --test .ci/*.test.mjs`: **228/228 passed** (0 failed, 0 skipped)
- `bash -n .ci/run-e2e.sh`, `bash -n .ci/use-local-swarm-cache.sh`, YAML validation on `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: **passed**
- `node .ci/test-selector.mjs check`: **passed** (11 cases, 20 tags, 4 layers)
- `node scripts/check-doc-links.mjs`: **passed** (143 Markdown files checked)
- `node scripts/check-architecture.mjs`: **passed** (392 package source files checked)
- `CI_ENFORCE_SOURCE_MAP=1 node .ci/changed-path-check.mjs`: **passed** (0/0 mapped)
- `node test/check-e2e-meta.mjs`: **passed** (127 spec files, 0 errors)

### Full 4-way concurrent self-hosted Docker benchmark (`bc801d94d`, 16 vCPU / 60.6 GiB host)
All 4 target merge-queue jobs executed concurrently in isolated `sd-actions-runner:local` containers with `CI_E2E_LOCAL_CONCURRENCY=2` on `standard-config` and `standard-journeys`:
- **`UT`** (`merge` + `--coverage`): **8345/8345 passed** in **561s (9m21s)**

A report's `[evidenceN]` chip opened 科学记忆 scoped to the report's Session, and the persisted chip references carried no owning Session. Citing a node created in an earlier Session of the same project therefore always showed "This memory was not found", implying the record was deleted.

## Changes
- Card-side fallback: read the citation's scope first; when nothing matches and the citation names no Session, read once unscoped and use the hit's `sessionId` for provenance. Budget refusals and an unreachable or disabled service stay "unavailable", never "missing".
- The unscoped read is limited to `GLOBALLY_UNIQUE_ID_LABELS` (`Artifact`, `Evidence`, `SourceFile`), whose node id is the record's own key. `DbRecord` is excluded on purpose: its id is the bare `identifier` and the graph keys those nodes by `(session_id, source, identifier)`, so a citation that names no Session returns `unlocated` instead of accepting a same-id record from another Session. The stale "Node ids are globally unique" comment now states this actual semantics.
- A page the sidecar cut short is not proof that nothing exists. `resolveCitation` carries `truncated` out of the scoped and the unscoped read alike and returns the new `unlocated` outcome instead of `missing`; `missing` is now reachable only from a page the sidecar did not cap.
- `memory.notFoundBody` (en/zh) now only says no record matches the citation; an outage keeps its own message, and `unlocated` has its own copy (`memory.unlocatedTitle` / `unlocatedBody`, en/zh) so it never renders the not-found sentence.
- New citations carry the owning Session: the sidecar's `cited_targets`/`chip_map` gain `session_id`, `toChipMap()` copies it, and the report reference persists it. Artifact chips keep none because the artifact dialog resolves them through the project.

## Validation
All numbers below were produced in the task checkout at head `c5ac07e1141e911971859730c8fe9973eb426968` (tree `aa11afc5302aec0f80fd67c2391f9f66524f81f3`), after `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`; each names the local log it comes from. - Regression tests against the previous implementation: with only the changed source files restored to `76bf461c` and the new tests kept, the two touched test files give 37 tests / 30 passed / 7 failed, failing exactly on the truncated-page cases (scoped, widened, own-Session, already-unscoped) and the foreign same-id `DbRecord` cases (log: `.tmp/prefix-run.log`).
- Sandboxed layers: `pnpm ci:ut` / `ci:st` / `ci:e2e` still cannot preflight in the task environment — `BUBBLEWRAP_UNAVAILABLE`, no user namespaces, planned 8148/63/189 and executed 0. They are reported as **not run locally**, not as passing; the sandbox-free equivalent is the build + desktop UT + typecheck above, and the containerised layers come from this PR's CI.

Select CI policy, L1, UT, ST, Docker image and Binary release (x86_64/aarch64) succeeded; L4/L5, mocked E2E and the macOS installer are skipped by policy for this change.

## Evidence
Captured in the desktop UI (Chromium 1280×800 CSS viewport at DPR 2) through the desktop E2E mocked control plane. The report lives in `session-1` and cites `[evidence1]`; that Evidence node belongs to another Session, `session-2`.
